In the bottom plating in a ballast tank, the thickness diminution may be due to, general corrosion , pitting corrosion, grooving corrosion or erosion corrosion. Where would you look for pitting corrosion?
options: Under suction heads for ballast line.
In way of cut-outs for drainage.

CD0117 — Integrated Survey Programme - I.question: Coating is applied in ballast tanks for protection of steel against corrosion. Which type of coating is not considered by the class to be an efficient corrosion protection system?
Below you have find an example of coating condition in a ballast tank. Provided this condition is representative throughout the tank what would be the correct rating according to your judgement?
What is the Integrated Survey Programme, ISP?
options: A maintenance programme for cargo ships.
A hull inspection and maintenance programme for container ships.
A maintenance system for machinery on container ships.
A survey program, which is integrated in the maintenance system onboard.
CD0117 — Integrated Survey Programme - I.answer: A hull inspection and maintenance programme for container ships.

CD0117 — Integrated Survey Programme - I.question: Pitting corrosion is most commonly found on horizontal surface in:
When doing inspections of the upper deck area, where would you not find cracks immediately?
options: At the lashing bridges connection to the deck.
At the middle of hatch end coaming.
At the hatch end coaming brackets.
CD0117 — Integrated Survey Programme - I.answer: At the middle of hatch end coaming.

CD0117 — Integrated Survey Programme - I.question: Which is required from the crew on board for practising of ISP?
options: Carry out inspections in accordance with the maintenance system on board, which has been accepted by the class.
Carry out inspections when deemed necessary.
Carry out inspections and report in accordance with the maintenance system, which has been accepted by the class.
Carry out inspections and submit report to the class.
CD0117 — Integrated Survey Programme - I.answer: Carry out inspections and report in accordance with the maintenance system, which has been accepted by the class.

CD0117 — Integrated Survey Programme - I.question: Which is outside the scope of Planned Inspection and Maintenance System (PIMS)?
options: Survey of ballast tanks with Fair coating.

CD0117 — Integrated Survey Programme - I.question: During inspection of the aft peak, where are cracks unlikely to be found?
options: Vibration crack at connection between floor and hull plating.
Fatigue cracks at the top of tanks.
CD0117 — Integrated Survey Programme - I.answer: Fatigue cracks at the top of tanks.

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: Which one of the following statements best describes the purpose of the upper radial bearing in a rotary vane steering gear, and how it is lubricated?
options: It takes up the radial loads generated by horizontal forces on the rudder and is lubricated by the steering gear system oil
It takes up the radial loads generated by horizontal forces on the rudder and is separately lubricated by oil or grease
It takes up the radial loads generated by the weight of the rudder and is lubricated by the steering gear system oil
It takes up the radial loads generated by the weight of the rudder and is separately lubricated by oil or grease
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: It takes up the radial loads generated by horizontal forces on the rudder and is lubricated by the steering gear system oil

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: Select from the following the type of rudder that is most commonly used on ferries and smaller ships?
options: Spade rudder, because of its good manoeuvrability
Semi-spade rudder, because of the reduced steering gear torque required
All three types are equally used
Flap rudder, because of its very good manoeuvrability
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: Spade rudder, because of its good manoeuvrability

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: Which one of the following statements correctly describes the main purpose of the rudder carrier bearing?
options: To support the weight of the rudder and any downward forces on the rudder caused by waves
To take up any forces caused by the weight of the rudder, and upwards or downward forces on the rudder caused by waves
To support the weight of the rudder when the steering gear is being maintained in dry-dock
To align the rudderstock and take up any radial forces caused by waves
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: To support the weight of the rudder and any downward forces on the rudder caused by waves

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: What is the main purpose of a rapson slide when fitted to a ram type steering gear?
options: The purpose of the rapson slide is to change the linear motion of the rams into circular motion of the tiller
The purpose of the rapson slide is to carry the weight of the rudder
The purpose of the rapson slide is to keep the rams correctly aligned to prevent sideways force on the ram seals
The purpose of the rapson slide is to limit the maximum movement of the rudder
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: The purpose of the rapson slide is to change the linear motion of the rams into circular motion of the tiller

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: Which one of the following are the clearances on a ram type steering gear that need to be checked at dry-dock?
options: Jumping clearance and carrier bearing wear-down clearance
Swivel block to guide bar clearance
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: Jumping clearance and carrier bearing wear-down clearance

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: Select the one statement that best completes the statement "The maximum required working torque of a steering gear is determined by ...
options: ... the torque necessary to turn the rudder to the maximum required angle at the ship's full speed and maximum draft"
... the effective torque at the relief valve opening pressure"
... the friction at the bearings and other moving parts"
... the resistance it meets in service, so there is no limit"
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: ... the torque necessary to turn the rudder to the maximum required angle at the ship's full speed and maximum draft"

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: Which one of the following best describes where the forces on the rudder arrangement come from?
options: Propeller, waves, weight of components and side forces
Weight of ship, propeller, waves and side force
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: Propeller, waves, weight of components and side forces

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: Which of the following statements best describes the typical maintenance program for changing the hydraulic oil used in steering gear?
options: Even small solid particles will cause wear, whilst moisture will cause corrosion so the oil needs to be changed regularly
Provided the oil remains incompressible oil changes are not required
Steering gear power actuators are very robust and oil should never need to be changed
Provided the oil viscosity remains within acceptable limits, the oil does not need changing
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: Even small solid particles will cause wear, whilst moisture will cause corrosion so the oil needs to be changed regularly

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: Which of the following best describes how the tiller or a rotary vane steering gear is connected to the rudderstock?
options: The tiller or rotary vane can be connected to the rudder stock by being hydraulically forced onto a taper, by keys, bolts or a combination of these methods
The tiller or rotary vane must always be connected to the rudder stock by  being forced onto a taper
The tiller or rotary vane is usually connected to the rudder stock by a nut which pushes it against a stepped shaft
The tiller or rotary vane must always be keyed to the rudder stock and held in place by a nut
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: The tiller or rotary vane can be connected to the rudder stock by being hydraulically forced onto a taper, by keys, bolts or a combination of these methods

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: Which one of the following statements best describes the importance of the purity of the hydraulic oil used in steering gear?
options: Even small solid particles will cause wear, whilst moisture will cause corrosion
Provided the oil remains incompressible, the steering gear will continue to work correctly
Steering gear power actuators are very robust and therefore a degree of oil contamination can be tolerated
Provided the oil viscosity remains within acceptable limits, the steering gear will continue to work correctly
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: Even small solid particles will cause wear, whilst moisture will cause corrosion

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: Which one of these statements about power supplies to electric and electro-hydraulic system for steering gears is correct?
options: The steering gear motors are fitted with alarms for overload, but to avoid loss of steering will only trip in the event of an electrical short circuit
To protect the steering gear motors, they are fitted with trips for overload, loss of one phase from a 3-phase supply and electrical short circuit

The steering gear motors are fitted with alarms for overload, loss of one phase from a 3-phase supply and electrical short circuit, but to avoid loss of steering will not trip in the event of any of these conditions
Because the second steering gear motor will start automatically, the alarms and trips fitted are decided by the shipbuilder
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: The steering gear motors are fitted with alarms for overload, but to avoid loss of steering will only trip in the event of an electrical short circuit

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: Which one of these statements about rudder carrier bearings for rotary vane steering gears is most accurate?
options: Rotary vane steering gears may be fitted with external rudder carrier bearings, but in many designs the rudder carrier bearing is part of the rotary vane unit
Rotary vane steering gears cannot be fitted with external rudder carrier bearings
Rotary vane steering gears are always fitted with external rudder carrier bearings
Rotary vane steering gears do not need rudder carrier bearings
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: Rotary vane steering gears may be fitted with external rudder carrier bearings, but in many designs the rudder carrier bearing is part of the rotary vane unit

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: Which one of the following are the alarms that should be fitted to an electro-hydraulic steering gear according to the SOLAS rules?
options: Power failure for the motors, power failure for the control system, failure of any phase of a three phase electrical supply, electrical overload, and low level alarms for each hydraulic fluid reservoir.
Power failure for the motors, power failure for the control system, electrical short circuit, electrical overload, and low level alarms for each hydraulic fluid reservoir

Power failure for the motors, power failure for the control system, failure of any phase of a three phase electrical supply, electrical short circuit, and low level alarms for each hydraulic fluid reservoir
Power failure for the motors, power failure for the control system, and low level alarms for each hydraulic fluid reservoir
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: Power failure for the motors, power failure for the control system, failure of any phase of a three phase electrical supply, electrical overload, and low level alarms for each hydraulic fluid reservoir.

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: Which one of the following statements best describes why SOLAS requires hand rails, gratings and non-slip surfaces to be fitted in the steering compartment?
options: So that there is safe access to the steering gear immediately for repairs, even in heavy weather.
Because it is usual for steering gears to leak oil
To save time when the steering gear is opened up for inspection in dry dock
To ensure that the ship owner will be not be liable for any injuries due to slips.
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: So that there is safe access to the steering gear immediately for repairs, even in heavy weather.

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: Which one of the following identifies where the changeover to local steering is carried out?
options: The steering compartment, but it must be acknowledged by the bridge before it can take effect
The engine control room or the bridge
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: The steering compartment

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: Which one of the following options best describes the main things that affect the torque needed to turn the rudder?
options: Size and type of rudder and the ship’s speed
Size and shape of the hull
The maximum displacement of the ship and the prevailing weather
The type of steering gear fitted
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: Size and type of rudder and the ship’s speed

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: Which one of these statements best describes the main effect of using two steering gear hydraulic pumps instead of one?
options: The speed of rudder movement is greatly increased
The force on the rudder is greatly increased
The speed of rudder movement and the force on the rudder are greatly increased
There is little effect on the speed of movement or the force on the rudder, but reliability is increased
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: The speed of rudder movement is greatly increased

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: Which one of the following is most likely to cause the hydraulic lock alarm to operate on a steering gear system?
options: A failure in the control system such as a directional valve sticking open
A failure of one of the hydraulic pumps
Having both hydraulic pumps running at the same time
Failing to purge the system of air
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: A failure in the control system such as a directional valve sticking open

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: Which of the following is the amount of hydraulic oil that must be held in the fixed storage tank connected by piping to the steering gear according to SOLAS?
options: Enough to recharge one power actuating system
Enough to recharge at least two power actuating systems
Enough to recharge all power actuating systems
Enough to make up expected leakage for the voyage
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: Enough to recharge one power actuating system

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: Which one of the following statements best describes where SOLAS says that you must be able to disconnect the bridge control of the steering gear?
options: From within the steering gear compartment
From the emergency headquarters and the bridge
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: From within the steering gear compartment

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: Which one of the following is a special steering gear requirement that passenger ships must meet that not all other ships require according to SOLAS?
options: They, must be able to move the rudder from 35° on either side to 30° on the other side in not more than 28 seconds with one power unit out of operation
They must have a main and auxiliary steering gear
There must be oil leakage detection.
For a single failure, steering capability must be regained within 45 seconds
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: They, must be able to move the rudder from 35° on either side to 30° on the other side in not more than 28 seconds with one power unit out of operation

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: Which one of the following is NOT said to be an advantage of ram type steering gears compared to rotary vane type steering gears?
options: Ram type steering gears require lower operating pressures
Ram type steering gears are of simple construction
Ram type steering gears are easier to maintain
On ram type steering gears, the torque increases with rudder angle, whereas for rotary vane types it is constant
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: Ram type steering gears require lower operating pressures

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: Which one of these statements about types of steering gear is true?
options: Higher pressures are needed for the ram type
Higher pressures are needed for the rotary vane type
A greater angle of possible rudder movement is available with ram type steering gears
The ram type takes up less space than the rotary vane type
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: Higher pressures are needed for the ram type

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: When a heavy sea strikes the rudder, which one of these statements best describes what will happen?
options: If the force is large enough, the hydraulic pressure in the steering gear will be high enough to operate the relief valve, and the rudder will move
The rudder is hydraulically locked in position and will not move
The rudder is free to move, but the auto-pilot will bring the ship back on course
The shape and lightweight design of the rudder means that wave forces have no effect
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: If the force is large enough, the hydraulic pressure in the steering gear will be high enough to operate the relief valve, and the rudder will move

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: SOLAS requires the fitting of visible and audible low level alarms for every steering gear hydraulic fluid reservoir. Which one of the following identifies the locations where it states that these alarms must be fitted?
options: On the bridge and in the machinery space, where they can be seen
On the bridge and in the steering compartment, where they can be seen
In the steering compartment and in the engine control room, where they can be seen
On the bridge, in the steering compartment and in the engine control room, where they can be seen
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: On the bridge and in the machinery space, where they can be seen

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: Select the phrase which most accurately completes the following statement. “According to the SOLAS rules the rudder speed should be at least 35-0-30 degrees in a maximum of 28 seconds for ...
options: ... the main steering gear of all ships, other than those with special requirements, such as those with non-conventional steering arrangements
... only cargo ships above 10,000 DWT or passenger ships carrying more than 50 passengers
... the main and auxiliary steering gear of all ships, other than those with special requirements, such as those with non-conventional steering arrangements
... only oil and chemical tankers and gas carriers
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: ... the main steering gear of all ships, other than those with special requirements, such as those with non-conventional steering arrangements

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: Which one of the following factors do you think will NOT affect the lifetime of the bearings in a rotary vane steering gear actuator?
options: The alignment of rudder stock with the steering gear installation
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: The relief valve pressure setting

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: Which one of the following statements best describes the difference in SOLAS requirements for the steering gears of single rudder tankers above and below 100,000 tonnes?
options: Below 100,000 tonnes, non duplicated hydraulic rudder actuators may be installed, provided they meet IMO guidelines. Above 100,000 tonnes, there must always be full duplication.
Below 100,000 tonnes, oil leakage detection is optional. Above 100,000 tonnes, oil leakage detection is always required.
Below 100,000 tonnes, an automatic change-over for oil leakage is optional. Above 100,000 tonnes, an automatic change-over for oil leakage is always required.
Below 100,000 tonnes, the power units can be different sizes. Above 100,000 tonnes, two or more identical power units are required.
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: Below 100,000 tonnes, non duplicated hydraulic rudder actuators may be installed, provided they meet IMO guidelines. Above 100,000 tonnes, there must always be full duplication.

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: Which one of these statements about the force developed by a hydraulic system is true?
options: Force equals pressure divided by area
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: Force equals pressure times area

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: Which one of the following is the main purpose of the relief valve on a hydraulic steering gear?
options: To protect the actuator against too high an oil pressure
To protect against leakage between the pressure chambers
To regulate the return flow of oil from the steering gear
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: To protect the actuator against too high an oil pressure

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: Select from the following the one feature that the steering gear of all ships greater than 70,000 tonnes displacement must have that not every other ship requires according to SOLAS?
options: Two or more identical power units
A main and auxiliary steering gear
Duplication of all components up to the rudderstock
A means of quickly restoring steering in the event of a single hydraulic failure in the hydraulic system.
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: Two or more identical power units

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: Which one of the following is the most important factor in reducing wear in a hydraulic steering gear system?
options: Ensuring the cleanliness of the hydraulic oil is maintained
Using both steering gear motors as often as possible
Using only one steering gear motor as often as possible
Limiting the maximum helm angle when using the auto-pilot
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: Ensuring the cleanliness of the hydraulic oil is maintained

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: Which one of these statements about rudder carrier bearings is true?
options: A separate rudder carrier bearing is only required on ram type steering gears
A rudder carrier bearing is only required on ram type steering gears
A rudder carrier bearing is only required on rotary vane type steering gears
A rudder carrier bearing is not required on rotary vane type steering gears
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: A separate rudder carrier bearing is only required on ram type steering gears

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: Which one of the following is most likely to cause the safety valve on a steering gear hydraulic system to operate?
options: A heavy sea has hit the rudder
The output pressure from the hydraulic pumps is too high
It has been opened as part of the normal operation of the steering gear
An attempt has been made to put too much helm on, too quickly
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: A heavy sea has hit the rudder

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: Which one of the following statements best describes the pressure to which the steering gear relief valves are set?
options: Slightly lower than the maximum working pressure
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: Slightly lower than design pressure

CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.question: Which one of the following is the main advantage of running two steering gear motors?
options: The speed of rudder movement will be doubled
The available rudder torque will be doubled
There is less chance of overheating the hydraulic fluid in hot weather
It reduces the wear on individual steering gear pumps
CD0118 — Steering Gear, RAM type.answer: The speed of rudder movement will be doubled

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: You respond by:
options: Yelling obscenities and accusing them of taking advantage of you to further their ridiculous aims.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: You respond by:
options: Shouting back not to shoot at the terrorists because they haven’t harmed you.
Laying down on the deck and covering your eyes.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: Laying down on the deck and covering your eyes.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: In response, you:
options: Offer to make something to eat.
Signal to the crew that now is the time to launch an attack to regain control of the ship.
Consider joining the terrorists since is doesn’t seem like help is going to come.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: Offer to make something to eat.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: You respond by:
options: Taunting them with the knowledge that help is on its way.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Given a mock-up of an explosive device, identify the components of the device with 100% accuracy.
Implement additional computer security methods.
options: That’s right! This objective is missing the condition and the standard. A better objective is “After completing a review of existing computer security methods, implement additional computer security methods that will protect the sensitive electronic information onboard the ship.”

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: In a role-play scenario, perform a physical search on a crewmember and locate a hidden weapon within one minute.
options: You got it! This objective communicates the behaviour, condition and standard.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Identify suspicious behaviours with 100% accuracy.
options: That’s right! This objective is missing the condition. A better objective is “In a practice drill focusing on profiling embarking visitors and crew, identify suspicious behaviours with 100% accuracy.”

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Understand the steps to completing a Ship Security Assessment.
options: That’s right! This objective doesn’t clearly communicate behaviour or what the participant will be doing when the objective is demonstrated. It’s also missing the condition and the standard. A better objective is “Without referring to the course material, list the steps to completing a Ship Security Assessment in the correct order, and without missing a step.”

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Using the information gathered in the Ship Security Assessment, create a Ship Security Plan.
options: You got it! This objective is missing the standard. A better objective is “Using the information gathered in the Ship Security Assessment, create a Ship Security Plan that meets the requirements laid out in the ISPS Code and addresses known gaps in the ship’s existing security measures.”

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Voyage itinerary
options: That’s right! Information about your ship’s route in itineraries and charts allows the terrorists to plan and execute an attack on your ship when it’s at sea.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Training records
options: That’s right! Access to the training records does little to help the terrorists plan and execute their attack.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Ship schematic
options: That’s right! The terrorist group can use the schematics and drawings of your ship’s design to plan how they will board your ship, hide their weapons and even position explosives to help them secure the ship or destroy communication and navigation systems.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Departure and arrival time
options: That’s right! Timings such as your ship’s scheduled arrival and departure can be used by the terrorists to determine when to execute their attack.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: HR policies
options: That’s right! These policies contain information that is of little use to the terrorists in planning and executing their attack.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Emergency response procedures
options: That’s right! Fire and other emergency and security procedures will provide the terrorists with insight into your ship’s likely response to an attack, and enable them to counter your response.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Planned maintenance schedule
options: That’s right! When and what equipment your ship services will not be of much use to the terrorists in planning and executing their attack.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Way points
The middle portion of a training program takes the most time to plan. Which of these items will assist you in planning and delivering this portion of the program?
options: A description of the content to be covered.
A list of the page references to regulations and other documents that will be referred to in the program.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Using x-ray equipment, perform a baggage search to locate a small hunting knife. Which instructional technique is appropriate for this objective?
When handling drugs:
options: Wear skin protection and a facemask.
Briefly inhale powders, fumes or vapours to verify the substance is a drug.
Shut off the ventilation in the room where the drugs are being stored to ensure any vapours or fumes do not spread to other parts of the ship.
Test out the potency of the drug.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: Wear skin protection and a facemask.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: All training programs have a beginning, a middle and an end.
This is an example of a good learning objective: Given a mock-up of an explosive device, identify the components of the device with 100% accuracy.
If drugs or suspected drugs are found onboard your ship, follow the five C’s. Confirm, Clear, Cordon, Control and:
If drugs are discovered onboard your ship:
options: Notify the authorities after you arrive at the next port of call.
Write a report a few days after the event and describe everything that occurred.
Disembark crew and passengers as quickly as possible at the next port of call so the authorities can conduct their investigation.
Ensure the witness to the discovery signs your incident report.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: Ensure the witness to the discovery signs your incident report.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Which of these precautionary measures can reduce the threat of piracy, if implemented?
options: Stay at least 15nm away from the shore.
Plan to arrive at port at night.
Turn off all of the ship’s lights at night.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Which of these actions should you take if your ship is successfully boarded by armed pirates?
options: Scream in fear and refuse to cooperate.
Keep quiet and ignore any questions you’re asked.
Assure your captors that you’re not planning an attack to overthrow them.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: Assure your captors that you’re not planning an attack to overthrow them.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Successful training programs build on learners past experience, are delivered with enthusiasm, present relevant information in a logical sequence and invite participation through varied activities.
How many different learning styles are there?
The process of learning involves doing, reflecting, linking and:
For a search to be effective it must be:
options: Conducted by personnel with limited knowledge of the ship’s layout.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Records relating to breaches of security and changes in security level must be secured against unauthorized access and available for review by contracting governments.
Your ship security plan must include procedures for responding to security threats, auditing security activities and interfacing with the port facility.
Searches are often triggered by:
options: An increase in security level by the Flag State.
The receipt of a shipment of damaged stores.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: An increase in security level by the Flag State.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Your ship is berthed at a port that is frequently used for drug smuggling. Which of these measures is it appropriate to implement?
options: Check the identity of everyone boarding the ship.
Secure unattended spaces that visitors have access to.
Limit the number of access points to the ship.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: Limit the number of access points to the ship.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: The Declaration of Security:
options: Addresses the security requirements shared between ships or between a port facility and a ship.
Identifies the security responsibilities of shipboard personnel.
States the reporting procedures to government contact points.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: Addresses the security requirements shared between ships or between a port facility and a ship.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Eavesdropping and phone taps are examples of which threat to information security?
Who is responsible for ensuring that your ship’s security plan meets the requirements of the ISPS Code?
One of the categories of information that must be included in your SSP is:
The DoS addresses the responsibility for the security of the water around the ship and the verification of increased threat levels.
In which of these circumstances can your ship request a DoS?
options: Your ship is operating at a lower security level than the ship or port it is interfacing with.
There is a heightened security risk for your ship and a port facility.
Your ship is conducting activities with a port or ship that is not required to implement an approved security plan.
Your ship has added a new port to its list of ports of call.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: Your ship is conducting activities with a port or ship that is not required to implement an approved security plan.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: What is an IED?
Which statement about IED’s is true?
options: All IED’s have four common components.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: All IED’s have four common components.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Who is responsible for completing the DoS on behalf of the ship?
Select from the options given the one piece of information which is considered the most sensitive from a ship’s security aspect?
options: Voyage itinerary with details of departure and arrival times.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: Voyage itinerary with details of departure and arrival times.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: The best way to identify an IED is to:
options: Measure the size of the object.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: What are the three tasks of a profiler?
options: Check documentation, conduct physical searches, ask questions.
Check documentation, ask questions, observe body language and behaviour.
Conduct physical searches, observe body language and behaviour, act intimidating.
Check documentation, conduct physical searches, act intimidating.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: Check documentation, ask questions, observe body language and behaviour.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Ship Security Plans all look the same.
What is the purpose of the Ship Security Plan?
options: Outline specific measures for your ship to move from security level 1 to 2 and from 2 to 3.
Outline the organizational structure for the ship.
Protect your ship from risks posed by security threats or incidents.
Detail the duties of shipboard personnel assigned security responsibilities.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: Protect your ship from risks posed by security threats or incidents.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Which of these statements about profiling is correct?
options: Verify that answers to questions match up with what’s already known about the person being questioned.
Check the ID of all visitors and some crew prior to boarding.
Pay less attention to body language and behaviour and more attention to answers to questions.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: Verify that answers to questions match up with what’s already known about the person being questioned.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Which of these are indications that a parcel is suspicious?
options: The parcel is addressed to no one in particular, arrives unexpectedly and seems heavy for its size.
The parcel came from Joe in the safety department and arrived quicker than expected.
The parcel is wrapped in clean, brown paper and is addressed to a crewmember from his wife.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: The parcel is addressed to no one in particular, arrives unexpectedly and seems heavy for its size.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Information about your ship’s security arrangements and procedures is stored electronically. Which of these measures will help safeguard it from potential threats?
Part way through a profiling interview with a supplier, the package the individual is carrying arouses your suspicion. What do you do?
options: Confront the individual and demand that he open the package.
Call for help on the radio.
Discreetly inform someone of your suspicions so he or she can get assistance.
Take the package and open it.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: Discreetly inform someone of your suspicions so he or she can get assistance.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Which of these weapons are widely available and commonly used by criminals and terrorists to further their aims?
The first step in completing an SSA is to:
options: Create a list of potential motives for security incidents against your ship.
Identify the key shipboard operations, systems, areas and personnel that are critical to protect.
Develop an onboard security survey checklist.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: Create a list of potential motives for security incidents against your ship.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Brainstorming potential motives for security incidents against your ship helps you to create possible threat scenarios.
What measures should be taken when handling mail?
options: Wear rubber gloves and protective clothing when opening suspicious looking mail.
X-ray or scan parcels before opening them.
Open any mail that looks suspicious.
Tear open letters with your hands.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: X-ray or scan parcels before opening them.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: During a profiling interview, the service man you are questioning starts to act suspiciously. He is:
options: Nervous, sweaty and trying to avoid eye contact.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: Nervous, sweaty and trying to avoid eye contact.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Which type of profiling is used to obtain information about rival companies and their employees?
You can reduce the need for security guards in certain areas by installing:
A Ship Security Assessment is integral to the creation of your ship’s security plan.
The best way to ensure you get the equipment you need is to:
options: Buy the most expensive equipment on the market.
Determine your needs and do some research.
Buy what everyone else is buying.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: Determine your needs and do some research.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Which statement about the use of profiling onboard a ship is true?
options: Detection equipment can be used in place of profiling.
Profilers need at least half an hour to gather the information they need.
A random selection process must be established.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: A random selection process must be established.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: This device can detect a package of drugs inside a large delivery of ship’s stores. What is it?
The purpose of profiling is to:
options: Make judgements about people based on their appearance.
Get beneath the outer shell of an individual to obtain a more complete picture.
Categorize people based on their nationality and ethnicity.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: Get beneath the outer shell of an individual to obtain a more complete picture.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Who is responsible for ensuring your ship completes a security assessment?
Which of these tasks is performed as part of the SSA?
options: Assign security duties to ship personnel.
Implement measures to address weaknesses in ship security.
Train shipboard personnel in their security duties.
Assess the likelihood and potential consequences of security incidents.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: Assess the likelihood and potential consequences of security incidents.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: A contractor is hired to install new navigation equipment onboard your ship while it’s berthed. For a period of time he’s left unsupervised and photographs schematics of the ship that he finds rolled up and stored in the corner of a nearby office. Later, from home, he hacks into the network and prints off information about the ship’s security procedures. Which of these information security measures would have prevented his unauthorized access?
options: Protective markings, reference checks, and passwords.
Firewall, protective markings, vetting and a secure network.
Secure area, passwords, a firewall and a secure network.
Secure area, passwords, a firewall and protective markings.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: Secure area, passwords, a firewall and a secure network.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Which type of equipment can be used to detect explosives?
Which of these statements about drug smuggling is true?
options: Drugs are difficult to conceal onboard a ship.
Drug smuggling is only a problem in certain ports, so only ships sailing in those ports need to implement preventative measures.
The preventative measures you incorporate into your ship’s security plan should be exhaustive, regardless of the level of threat identified by your ship’s security assessment.
The risks to ships are not restricted to specific areas or trading routes.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: The risks to ships are not restricted to specific areas or trading routes.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: The International Maritime Bureau Piracy Reporting Centre attributes the increased numbers of hijackings to:
options: The greater involvement in piracy of well-organized and armed crime networks.
Higher crime rates around the world.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: The greater involvement in piracy of well-organized and armed crime networks.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: The best way to prevent stowaways from boarding your ship is to:
options: Conduct routine, but irregular searches of the ship.
Search the ship when you arrive at port and again just after leaving.
Seal spaces that are not in use while in port, and perform a search of the ship before leaving.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: Seal spaces that are not in use while in port, and perform a search of the ship before leaving.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Only search vehicle compartments where you suspect objects may be hidden.
Which of these actions should crew take if a suspicious object that may be a bomb is located during a search?
options: Cover the suspicious object with a box or blanket.
Confirm with their search partner that the object found is suspicious.
Place the object in a desk drawer or file cabinet.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: Confirm with their search partner that the object found is suspicious.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Which of this information must be included in a piracy attack alert?
options: The type of weapons being carried by the pirates/highjackers.
Your ship’s name and call sign.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: Your ship’s name and call sign.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Assign men to search men and women to search women unless a device such as a metal detector is used.
The most effective way to combat the threat of drug smuggling is to:
options: Organize crew into pairs and conduct weekly searches of the ship.
Combining routine, but irregular searches of the ship with spontaneous targeted searches.
Perform routine, but irregular searches using teams of two or more personnel from the same department.
Perform spontaneous targeted searches using teams of two or more personnel from the same department.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: Combining routine, but irregular searches of the ship with spontaneous targeted searches.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: The person who takes a bomb threat call has an opportunity to extract information about the bomb from the caller.
Which of these statements about drug smugglers modes of operating is true?
options: Individual entrepreneurs usually smuggle large quantities of drugs.
Drugs smuggled by an organized conspiracy are usually concealed in a primary ship system such as the engine room or in a tank, void or compartment.
Drugs hidden by individual entrepreneurs are usually difficult to detect.
An organized conspiracy usually smuggles a small amount of drugs.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: Drugs smuggled by an organized conspiracy are usually concealed in a primary ship system such as the engine room or in a tank, void or compartment.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: You’ve just completed a training drill. Which of these guidelines should you follow when giving feedback?
options: Listen to your hunches and give appropriate feedback.
Ask to give feedback or wait to be asked.
Take a one-hour break for lunch and give feedback after you resume.
Give lots of information and examples.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: Ask to give feedback or wait to be asked.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: What do crew, visitors and contractors all have in common?
options: They’re all employees of the ship.
They’re all onboard the ship for the duration of its voyage.
They all have opportunity to smuggle drugs.
They’re all trained in ship emergency procedures.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: They all have opportunity to smuggle drugs.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Which information should be included in your search plan?
options: Personnel to be involved in the search.
Known hiding spots to be searched.
Areas to the searched and personnel to be involved in the search.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: Areas to the searched and personnel to be involved in the search.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Which of these are indicators that an individual may be a drug smuggler?
options: The individual spends his or her free time hanging out with others.
The individual wears bulky or out of season clothing.
The individual makes small local purchases.
The individual is disinterested in the ship’s cargo.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: The individual wears bulky or out of season clothing.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: What type of bomb search should you conduct to avoid panic when the credibility of the threat is in doubt and you don’t want to disrupt ship business?
Which of these procedures should crew follow when conducting a search?
options: Stand quietly in various spots around the space, listening for unusual sounds like the tick tock of a clock mechanism.
Search the perimeter of the space up to a height of 5 feet.
Wait in the area they’ve finished searching until they’re contacted for a status update.
Conduct random or spot checks of logical threat areas.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: Stand quietly in various spots around the space, listening for unusual sounds like the tick tock of a clock mechanism.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Which of these measures would you implement to prevent drugs from being smuggled onboard your ship while it’s berthed?
options: Check a portion of the bags and packages brought onboard.
Search some of the packages, spares and stores received.
Eliminate fore and aft deck watch at night.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Question: What level of security does the Ship Security Officer implement?
Question: This situation calls for security measures corresponding to Security Level:
Question: Which of these measures should the SSO implement to tighten control over access to the ship?
options: Segregate embarking crew and visitors from disembarking crew and visitors.
Reduce the number of access points to the ship and adequately secure those to be closed.
Limit access to the ship to personnel responding to the security threat.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: Limit access to the ship to personnel responding to the security threat.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Question: If you were the SSO, which of these measures would you ensure are in place?
options: Periodically check the cargo to ensure it matches the cargo documentation.
Routinely check the cargo, cargo spaces and cargo transport units.
Examine the cargo more frequently and in greater detail.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: Examine the cargo more frequently and in greater detail.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Question: To monitor the security of the ship what should the SSO do?
options: Assign additional personnel as security lookouts.
Reduce speed to make the voyage more comfortable for the lookouts.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: Assign additional personnel as security lookouts.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Question:  This ship is operating at Security Level:
Question: Which of these security measures are appropriate when loading the stores onto the ship?
options: Intensify the physical inspection of the stores to identify damaged or adulterated goods.
Check that the stores match the order before being loaded on board.
Refuse to accept the stores on board because some items were damaged in transit.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: Check that the stores match the order before being loaded on board.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Question: Which of these security measures should be in place?
options: Access points to the restricted areas are continuously monitored by surveillance equipment.
Restricted areas are searched periodically, according to schedule.
Access points to the restricted areas are locked or secured.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: Access points to the restricted areas are locked or secured.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: Question: What should the SSO do with it?
options: Search half of the equipment before loading it onto the ship.
Immediately load the equipment onboard so the repair work can get started.
Refrain from loading the equipment until the threat has passed.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: Refrain from loading the equipment until the threat has passed.

CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.question: So what is the purpose of the SSP anyway? ^MListed below are four possible purpose statements. ^MClick on the right choice
options: Specify the measures for your ship to move from security level 1 to 2 and from 2 to 3.
Outline the organizational structure of security for the ship.
Detail the duties of shipboard personnel assigned security responsibilities.
Protect your ship from risks posed by security threats or incidents.
Good try! This is an element of an SSP not a description of its purpose.

That’s right! The SSP is implemented to safeguard your ship against security threats and incidents. It addresses the various features of your ship and the potential threats and vulnerabilities to its security.
CD0121 — Ship Security Officer Training.answer: Protect your ship from risks posed by security threats or incidents.

CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.question: Inside a special area, and if more than 12 nautical miles from land and en-route, what types of garbage can be discharged overboard? Select ANY answers that you think apply
options: Food waste, either ground or not ground.
Food waste, if ground and placed in plastic bags.
Food waste, cardboard, paper and similar bio-degradable materials.
CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.answer: Ground food waste

CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.question: Какие виды мусора разрешается выбрасывать за борт в пределах специально отведенных зон на расстоянии не менее 12 морских миль от берега по пути следования судна? Выберите ВСЕ подходящие, по вашему мнению, варианты ответов
options: Пищевые отходы, измельченные и упакованные в пластиковые пакеты.
Пищевые отходы, картон, бумагу и подобные биоразлагаемые материалы.
CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.answer: Измельченные пищевые отходы

CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.question: Özel bir alan içerisinde ve karadan 12 deniz milinden daha fazla açıkta ve seyir halindeyken gemiden ne tür çöpler denize atılabilir? Geçerli olduğunu düşündüğünüz HERHANGİ BİR cevabı seçin
options: Öğütülmüş ya da öğütülmemiş gıda atıkları.
Öğütülmüş ve plastik torbalara koyulmuşsa gıda atığı.
Gıda atıkları, karton, kağıt ve benzeri biyoçözünür malzemeler.
CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.answer: Öğütülmüş gıda atıkları

CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.question: 在特殊区域内，如果离开陆地 12 海里和在途中，可以舷侧排放哪些类型的生活垃圾？ 请选择所有适用答案。
options: 研磨或未研磨的食物残渣。
研磨并放在塑料袋中的食物残渣。
食物残渣、箱子、纸和类似可生物降解的材料。
CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.answer: 研磨的食物残渣

CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.question: No interior de uma área especial e se estiver a mais de 12 milhas náuticas da terra e em navegação, que tipos de lixos podem ser descarregados fora de bordo? Selecione TODAS as respostas que considere que se apliquem
options: Resíduos de alimentos, moídos ou inteiros.
Resíduos de alimentos, se moídos e colocados em sacos de plástico.
Resíduos de alimentos, cartão, papel e materiais biodegradáveis semelhantes.
CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.answer: Resíduos de alimentos moídos

CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.question: ISO 14001 uses the term ‘environmental impact’. What does this mean? Select the ONE best answer.
options: Change to the environment, whether good or bad, resulting from the company’s activities.
Adverse change to the environment, resulting from the company’s activities.
Positive changes to the environment, resulting from the company’s activities.
CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.answer: Change to the environment, whether good or bad, resulting from the company’s activities.

CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.question: В ISO 14001 используется термин «воздействие на окружающую среду». Что он означает? Выберите ОДИН наиболее подходящий вариант ответа.
options: Изменения в окружающей среде, неблагоприятные или благоприятные, причиной которых является деятельность компании.
Неблагоприятные изменения в окружающей среде, причиной которых является деятельность компании.
Благоприятные изменения в окружающей среде, причиной которых является деятельность компании.
CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.answer: Изменения в окружающей среде, неблагоприятные или благоприятные, причиной которых является деятельность компании.

CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.question: ISO 14001 'çevresel etki' terimini kullanmaktadır. Bu terimin anlamı nedir? En iyi BİR cevap seçin.
options: Çevreyi değiştirmek iyi de olsa kötü de olsa şirketin faaliyetlerinin bir sonucudur.
Çevrenin olumsuz değişmesi şirketin faaliyetlerinin bir sonucudur.
Çevrenin olumlu değişimi şirketin faaliyetlerinin bir sonucudur.
CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.answer: Çevreyi değiştirmek iyi de olsa kötü de olsa şirketin faaliyetlerinin bir sonucudur.

CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.question: ISO 14001 使用“环境影响”一词。这个词是什么意思？ 请选择一个最佳答案。
options: 公司活动导致的负面的或有益的环境变化。
公司活动导致的负面环境变化。
公司活动导致的正面环境变化。
CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.answer: 公司活动导致的负面的或有益的环境变化。

CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.question: A ISO 14001 utiliza o termo "impacto ambiental". O que significa? Selecione a MELHOR resposta.
options: Alteração ao ambiente, adversa ou benéfica, resultante total ou parcialmente dos aspectos ambientais da empresa
Alteração ao ambiente, resultante das atividades da empresa.
Alterações positivas ao ambiente, resultante das atividades da empresa.
CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.answer: Alteração ao ambiente, adversa ou benéfica, resultante total ou parcialmente dos aspectos ambientais da empresa

CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.question: If engine room bilge water cannot be processed through an oily water separator, what should be done with it? Select ANY answers that you think apply.
options: It should be discharged to a shore reception facility.
It should be allowed to settle in a storage tank, which can then be lowered by pumping out overboard, keeping a watch for any oil in the overboard discharge.
It can be discharged overboard, if not in a special area, en-route and more than 50 miles from the nearest land or ice shelf.
CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.answer: It should be discharged to a shore reception facility.

CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.question: Как следует поступать с трюмной водой из машинного отделения, если ее невозможно очистить с помощью водомаслоотделителя? Выберите ВСЕ подходящие, по вашему мнению, варианты ответов.
options: Она должна быть доставлены на полигон по приему мусора на берегу.
Она должна отстаиваться в резервуаре для хранения, откуда затем ее можно откачать за борт, контролируя при этом содержание нефти в сбрасываемых водах.
Ее можно сбрасывать за борт за пределами специально отведенных зон по пути следования судна на расстоянии более 50 миль от ближайшего берега или шельфового ледника.
CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.answer: Она должна быть доставлены на полигон по приему мусора на берегу.

CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.question: Makine dairesi karina suyu yağlı su ayırıcı ile işlenemiyorsa bu konuda ne yapılmalıdır? Geçerli olduğunu düşündüğünüz HERHANGİ BİR cevabı seçin.
options: Suyun kıyı alım tesisine tahliye edilmesi gerekir.
Suyun, gemiden denize tahliyede herhangi bir yağa dikkat edilerek daha sonra gemiden denize pompalanarak seviyesi düşürülebilecek depolama tankına doldurulmasına izin verilmelidir.
Özel bir bölgede değilse, seyir halindeyse ve en yakın kara parçasından veya buz kitlesinden 50 milden daha uzaktaysa gemiden denize tahliye edilebilir.
CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.answer: Suyun kıyı alım tesisine tahliye edilmesi gerekir.

CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.question: 如果机房舱底水无法通过油水分离器进行处理，则应该如何处理？ 请选择所有适用答案。
options: 应该排放到岸上接收设施。
应允许放在存储罐中，然后可以将其泵出舷侧，并在舷侧排放期间监测看是否有油。
如果不是在特殊区域、在途中和在最近陆地或冰架 50 英里以上，则可以舷侧排放。
CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.answer: 应该排放到岸上接收设施。

CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.question: Se não for possível processar a água do porão da sala das máquinas através do separador de água, o que se pode fazer? Selecione TODAS as respostas que considere que se apliquem.
options: Deve ser descarregada em instalações de recolhimento em terra.
Deve assentar em um tanque de armazenamento, que pode depois ser baixado para bombear para fora de bordo, mantendo a atenção para qualquer descarga com teor de óleo ou petróleo.
Pode ser descarregada para fora de bordo, se não se tratar de uma área especial, em navegação e a mais de 50 milhas da plataforma de gelo ou do ponto terrestre mais próximo.
CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.answer: Deve ser descarregada em instalações de recolhimento em terra.

CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.question: What does ISO 14001 include in the term ‘the environment’? Select the ONE best answer.
options: All plant and animal life, air, water, land, natural resources, humans and their interrelationships.
All plant and animal life, air, water, and land which could be directly affected by shipping.
Marine plant and animal life, air, water, and land which could be directly affected by shipping.
CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.answer: All plant and animal life, air, water, land, natural resources, humans and their interrelationships.

CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.question: Что означает термин «окружающая среда» согласно ISO 14001? Выберите ОДИН наиболее подходящий вариант ответа.
options: Весь растительный и животный мир, воздух, вода, земля, природные ресурсы, люди и их взаимоотношения.
Весь растительный и животный мир, воздух, вода и земля, на которые судоходство может оказывать непосредственное воздействие.
Морские растения и животные, воздух, вода и земля, на которые судоходство может оказывать непосредственное воздействие.
CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.answer: Весь растительный и животный мир, воздух, вода, земля, природные ресурсы, люди и их взаимоотношения.

CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.question: ISO 14001 'çevre' terimine neyi dahil etmektedir? En iyi BİR cevap seçin.
options: Tüm bitki ve hayvan yaşamı, hava, su, toprak, doğal kaynaklar, insanlar ve aralarındaki ilişkileri.
Tüm bitki ve hayvan yaşamı, hava, su ve gemilerden doğrudan etkilenebilecek karalar.
Deniz bitkisi ve hayvanı yaşamı, hava, su ve gemilerden doğrudan etkilenebilecek karalar.
CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.answer: Tüm bitki ve hayvan yaşamı, hava, su, toprak, doğal kaynaklar, insanlar ve aralarındaki ilişkileri.

CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.question: ISO 14001 的“环境”一词包括什么？ 请选择一个最佳答案。
options: 所有植物和动物生命、空气、水、陆地、自然资源、人类以及相互之间的关系。
可能受船运直接影响的所有植物和动物生命、空气、水、陆地。
可能受船运直接影响的海洋植物和动物生命、空气、水、陆地。
CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.answer: 所有植物和动物生命、空气、水、陆地、自然资源、人类以及相互之间的关系。

CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.question: O que a ISO 14001 inclui no termo "o ambiente"? Selecione a MELHOR resposta.
options: Toda a vida vegetal e animal, ar, água, terra, recursos naturais, seres humanos e as suas inter-relações.
Toda a vida vegetal e animal, ar, água e terra que possam ser diretamente afetados pelo transporte marítimo.
A vida vegetal e animal marinha, ar, água e terra que possam ser diretamente afetados pelo transporte marítimo.
CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.answer: Toda a vida vegetal e animal, ar, água, terra, recursos naturais, seres humanos e as suas inter-relações.

CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.question: Where can we dispose of plastic?
options: At a shore reception facility only.
At a shore facility and at sea when more than 12 miles from land.
At a shore facility and at sea only outside special areas.

На полигонах на берегу и в море только за пределами специально отведенных зон.

CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.question: Onde podemos eliminar o plástico?

Em instalações em terra e no mar apenas fora das áreas especiais.

CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.question: Why should ship’s sewage be collected in a storage or treatment tank? Select the ONE best answer.

CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.question: Почему сточные воды судна необходимо собирать в резервуары для хранения или отстойники? Выберите ОДИН наиболее подходящий вариант ответа.

CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.question: Geminin atık suyunun neden depoda veya işlem tankında toplanması gerekir? En iyi BİR cevap seçin.

CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.question: 为什么船只生活污水要收集在存储罐或处理罐中？ 请选择一个最佳答案。

CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.question: ISO 14001 'uyum zorunlulukları' terimini kullanır. Bu terimin anlamı nedir? En iyi BİR cevap seçin.

CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.question: ISO 14001 使用“合规义务”一词。这个词是什么意思？ 请选择一个最佳答案。

CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.question: A ISO 14001 utiliza o termo "obrigações de conformidade". O que significa? Selecione a MELHOR resposta.

CD0122 — ISO 14001 Environmental Managem.question: What is ISO 14001? Select the ONE best answer.

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
船只已经靠岸，但未在装卸货物。船只 SMS 允许在没有许可证的机房车间内进行焊接，因为考虑到这是一个指定高温作业空间。
码头法规不允许进行靠岸高温作业。轮机长希望对一节管道的小裂缝进行维修，该管道已经断开并且取了下来。可以焊接这个裂缝吗？ （请选择最正确的答案）
options: 不行（尽管 SMS 对此有规定，但码头法规优先）。
可以（尽管码头法规不允许，但船上 SMS 优先）。
严格来说不行，但可以在夜间进行。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 不行（尽管 SMS 对此有规定，但码头法规优先）。

CD0125 — Hot work.question: Which of the following regulates hot work outside the designated space?
options: The SMS by means of a Permit to Work system.
The SMS through the company Risk Analysis Programme.
Instructions in the Chief Engineer’s Standing Orders.
Hot work outside the designated space is not regulated.
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: The SMS by means of a Permit to Work system.

CD0125 — Hot work.question: 以下哪项对指定空间之外的高温作业进行了规定？
options: SMS 通过作业许可证系统。
SMS 通过公司风险分析计划。
轮机长标准命令中的指令。
未对指定空间之外的高温作业进行规定。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: SMS 通过作业许可证系统。

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
What is the maximum concentration of hydrocarbon gas permitted in the atmosphere in a space
(not a designated space) before hot work can take place?
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: Less than 1% LFL.

CD0125 — Hot work.question: 开始高温作业之前，空间（非指定空间）内空气允许的碳氢气体的最大浓度是什么？
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 小于 1% LFL。

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
For hot work to take place in the machinery space, what is the minimum distance that it can take place from
a bunker tank containing fuel oil?
options: No welding can take place in a machinery space where any of the fuel storage tanks has not been cleaned to hot work standard and inspected and tested to that effect.
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: At least 500 mm.

CD0125 — Hot work.question: 对于要在机械空间进行的高温作业，距离燃油罐的最小距离是多少？
options: 在其中的燃油罐尚未清洁至高温作业标准，并经过检查和测试到达此效果的机械空间内，不能进行任何焊接作业。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 至少 500 毫米。

CD0125 — Hot work.question: Which of the following is the ISGOTT definition of a “Responsible Officer” (or “Responsible Person”)?
options: A person appointed by the employer or the Master of the ship and empowered to take all decisions relating to a specific task, having the necessary knowledge and experience for that purpose.
A person appointed by a terminal and empowered to take all decisions relating to a vessel alongside, having the necessary knowledge and experience for that purpose.
A seafarer with a Certificate of Competency.
An Officer who has been trained how to complete standard reporting forms.
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: A person appointed by the employer or the Master of the ship and empowered to take all decisions relating to a specific task, having the necessary knowledge and experience for that purpose.

CD0125 — Hot work.question: 以下哪个是 ISGOTT 关于“负责官员”（或“负责人”）的定义？
options: 雇主或船长指定的、具有做出具体任务相关所有决策的权力和必要知识和经验的人员。
码头指定的、具有做出靠岸船舶相关所有决策的权力和必要知识和经验的人员。
经过培训了解如何完成标准报告表格的官员。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 雇主或船长指定的、具有做出具体任务相关所有决策的权力和必要知识和经验的人员。

CD0125 — Hot work.question: Which of the following is considered as the best location on board for hot work?
options: A designated space, such as the engine room workshop.
A dedicated area, such as behind the accommodation block.
At the actual location of the required repair.
Anywhere behind the tank deck area.
There is no area on a tanker which is better than any other for hot work; it is equally dangerous all over the ship.
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: A designated space, such as the engine room workshop.

CD0125 — Hot work.question: 以下哪个位置应视为高温作业的最佳位置？
options: 机械空间内的任何地方。
罐体甲板区域背后的任何位置。
油轮上没有更好的区域来进行高温作业。整个船上都同样危险。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 指定空间，如机房车间。

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
It is intended to burn some old brackets off a bulkhead in the after end of the machinery space. The
bulkhead to a lubricating oil storage tank is 480 mm away from the closest bracket. Can the repair take place without further precautionary measures being taken?
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: No.

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
打算在机械空间的后端舱壁处烧掉一些旧的支架。
润滑油储存罐的舱壁距离最近的支架 480 毫米。如果不采取其他预防措施，是否可以进行维修？
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 不可以。

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
A section of pipe has been disconnected and taken aft to a dedicated gas safe area on the poop deck
behind the accommodation block. Is it necessary to perform a Risk Assessment?
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: Yes.

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
一节管道已经断开并取下放到舱室后面艉楼甲板上的专用气体安全区域。
是否需要进行风险评估？
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 需要。

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
On this tanker, a hot work repair is to take place in cargo tank 2P. Tank 3S is diagonally across the point
at which longitudinal and transverse tank bulkheads of the two tanks meet. Is tank 3S considered to be adjacent for the purposes of hot work requirements?
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: Yes.

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
在此油轮上，要在货物罐 2P 内进行高温作业维修。罐体 3S 对角线穿过两个罐体的纵向和横向罐体舱壁交叉点。
罐体 3S 是否要视为高温作业要求的临近区域？
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 是。

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
A hot work repair is required on a pipeline on the deck of a tanker. The first available flange at which the
pipeline can be disconnected and isolated is a long way aft, just in front of the pumproom. What recommended precaution will you follow while the repair is being carried out?
options: Continuously through-ventilating the pipeline with fresh air and monitoring the exhausting air for hydrocarbon vapour.
Flushing the pipeline continuously with fresh water.
Periodically blowing through the pipeline with inert gas and monitoring for oxygen content of at least 15%.
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: Continuously through-ventilating the pipeline with fresh air and monitoring the exhausting air for hydrocarbon vapour.

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
需要在油轮甲板上对管道进行高温作业维修。可用于断开和隔离管道的第一个法兰
距离船尾较远，位于泵室前面。执行维修时建议遵循什么推荐预防措施？
options: 使用新鲜空气对管道进行持续通风，并监控碳氢废气。
使用新鲜水持续冲刷管道。
使用惰性气体定期吹扫管道，并监控氧气含量使其至少为 15%。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 使用新鲜空气对管道进行持续通风，并监控碳氢废气。

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
A level monitor is to be installed in a slop tank on a chemical tanker that is not inerted. Hot work is required.
How should the space be treated before that work starts? (Select all applicable answers)
options: The tank should be thoroughly cleaned and gas freed to hot work standard.
It is not permitted to perform hot work in a dedicated slop tank, unless the vessel is in dry dock.
The tank should be pre-washed to remove the majority of residues.
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: The tank should be thoroughly cleaned and gas freed to hot work standard.

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
要在未进行惰性处理的化学品油轮上的一个污水罐中安装水位监视器。需要进行高温作业。
作业开始之前应如何处理该空间？ （选择所有适用答案）
options: 罐体应彻底清洁且排空气体，使其达到高温作业标准。
不允许在专用污水罐中进行高温作业，除非船舶处于干船坞中。
罐体应预先清洗以去除大部分残渣。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 罐体应彻底清洁且排空气体，使其达到高温作业标准。

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
On this tanker, a hot work repair is to be carried out at a height of 760mm above the tank deck. The ship
is not inerted. Cargo tanks within a specified distance, including those diagonally positioned, should either have been cleaned and gas freed to hot work standard, or completely filled with water. What is that specified distance?
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 30 metres.

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
在此油轮上，要在罐体甲板之上 760 毫米的高度进行高温作业维修。
船只未惰性处理。指定距离的货物罐，包括对角线位置的罐体均应清洁和排空气体至高温作业标准，或者已经完全充水。这个指定距离是多少？
When is a tank, compartment or container considered to be gas free?
options: When sufficient fresh air has been introduced into it to lower the level of any flammable, toxic, or inert gas to that required for a specific purpose.
When sufficient fresh air has been introduced into it to raise the level of oxygen present to that necessary to sustain human life, that is above 17.9%.
When sufficient inert gas has been introduced into it to prohibit the possibility of combustion in the presence of a source of ignition.
When a Senior Officer declares it to be fit for entry.
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: When sufficient fresh air has been introduced into it to lower the level of any flammable, toxic, or inert gas to that required for a specific purpose.

CD0125 — Hot work.question: 什么情况下会认为罐体、隔室或容器无气体？
options: 引入了足够的新鲜空气，使得任何可燃、有毒或惰性气体的浓度水平均降低到了特定目标（如罐体进入和高温作业）所需的浓度之下时。
引入了足够的新鲜空气，使得氧气提高到维持人员生命所需 17.9% 浓度时。
引入了足够的惰性气体，禁止了存在火源是燃烧的可能性时。
当高级官员声明这样是为了进入时。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 引入了足够的新鲜空气，使得任何可燃、有毒或惰性气体的浓度水平均降低到了特定目标（如罐体进入和高温作业）所需的浓度之下时。

CD0125 — Hot work.question: What is the definition of “cold work”?
options: Work which cannot create a source of ignition.
Work that creates a cold spark.
Work that will still create a spark in temperatures of less than 15.6°C.
Work that creates a spark in water.
Work which creates a source of ignition.
An atmosphere in which no flammable vapours are present.
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: Work which cannot create a source of ignition.

CD0125 — Hot work.question: “低温作业”的定义是什么？
options: 在 15.6°C 以下仍然会产生火花的作业。
在水中产生火花的作业。
不存在可燃气体的空气。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 不会产生火源的作业。

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
A what minimum distance is a hot work repair permitted from the bulkhead of a bunker tank, assuming it
has not been cleaned and tested for hot work?
假设尚未针对高温作业进行清洁和测试，那么最少离开燃油罐多远才允许进行高温作业维修？
Where portable lights are required to adequately illuminate a hot work site, how should they be used?
options: They should be clamped or otherwise secured in position, not hand-held, with leads kept clear of the working area.
They should be held by the assistant at a safe distance from the hot work, with leads kept clear of the working area.
Additional illumination from portable lights is not required; there is enough light from the hot work activity itself.
They should be suspended by natural fibre rope at a minimum distance of 2.5 metres from the hot work activity.
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: They should be clamped or otherwise secured in position, not hand-held, with leads kept clear of the working area.

CD0125 — Hot work.question: 如果需要移动灯具来让高温作业现场足够明亮时，应该如何使用？
options: 应该夹住或以其他方式固定，不要用手拿，并且电线要离开作业区域。
应该由辅助人员在高温作业安全距离处进行手持，并且电线要离开作业区域。
不需要附加的移动灯具照明； 高温作业活动本身的亮度已经足够。
应悬挂离高温作业活动处最少 2.5 米的自然纤维绳索上。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 应该夹住或以其他方式固定，不要用手拿，并且电线要离开作业区域。

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
How can a welder, working in a confined and restricted area and in close contact with the ship’s structure,
be additionally protected against the risk of electric shock through touching the hull or frames?
options: By providing dry insulating mats or boards.
By wearing a cotton boiler suit.
By flushing down the area with fresh water before welding commences.
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: By providing dry insulating mats or boards.

CD0125 — Hot work.question: 对于在受限空间内作业且会紧密接触船只结构的焊接人员来说，应如何针对接触船体或架构而导致的触电风险提供进一步的保护？
options: 提供干燥的绝缘垫片或垫板。
开始焊接之前用新鲜水冲刷该区域。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 提供干燥的绝缘垫片或垫板。

CD0125 — Hot work.question: When a ship is in dry-dock, which of the following primarily governs the management of all safety matters?
options: The national regulations of the country in which the dry-dock is located.
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: The shipyard SMS.

CD0125 — Hot work.question: 当船只位于干船坞中时，以下哪项主要管辖所有安全事项的管理？
options: 干船坞所在国家的国家法规。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 船厂 SMS。

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
Who is responsible for ensuring that adequate arrangements are provided for contractors or work gangs,
temporarily employed on board, to understand and comply with all relevant safe working practices?
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: The Master.

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
谁应该负责确保为船上临时雇佣的承包商或工作团队提供足够的安排，
使其理解并遵循所有相关安全作业规范？
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 船长。

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
Wherever possible and for safety, which of the following is the most preferable location for performing a
hot work repair on a cargo line valve?
options: In the designated space, having been disconnected and removed from the tank deck.
On the poop deck, behind the accommodation, having been disconnected and removed from the tank deck.
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: In the designated space, having been disconnected and removed from the tank deck.

CD0125 — Hot work.question: 如果可能，则安全起见，以下哪个位置是在货物管路阀门进行高温作业维修的最佳位置？
options: 在指定空间，已经断开并从罐体甲板取下。
在舱室后面的艉楼甲板上，已经断开并从罐体甲板取下。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 在指定空间，已经断开并从罐体甲板取下。

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
On this tanker, preparations have been made for a damaged ladder in cargo tank 4 centre to be cut
away and replaced. The tank has been thoroughly cleaned and gas freed. The vessel is at sea and all other compartments are inerted.  How should the inert gas line to 4 centre be treated, before the repair can take place?
options: It should be purged with inert gas to not more than 2% by volume of hydrocarbon vapour and isolated.
It should be purged with inert gas to not more than 8% by volume of hydrocarbon vapour and isolated.
It is not necessary to do anything with the inert gas line to 4 port.
It must be flushed through and gas freed, with the hydrocarbon vapour content reduced to not more than 1% LFL and maintained at that level.
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: It should be purged with inert gas to not more than 2% by volume of hydrocarbon vapour and isolated.

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
在此油轮上，准备切割和更换中间货物罐 4 中一个损坏的梯子。
罐体已经彻底清洁且排空了气体。船舶正在海上，所有其他隔室均已惰性处理。在开始维修之前，应该如何处理中间 4 号罐体的惰性气体管道？
options: 应该清除，使得惰性气体体积不超过碳氢气体的 2% 并进行隔离。
应该清除，使得惰性气体体积不超过碳氢气体的 8% 并进行隔离。
无需对左舷 4 号的惰性气体管道进行任何操作。
必须进行冲刷和气体排空，碳氢气体含量降低到不超过 1% LFL 并保持在该水平。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 应该清除，使得惰性气体体积不超过碳氢气体的 2% 并进行隔离。

CD0125 — Hot work.question: What approach does the ISM Code take towards safety?
options: It is based on Risk Assessment and Risk Management.
It requires extensive checklists to be completed at every stage.
It contains highly detailed procedures, covering all aspects of shipboard operation.
It seeks to identify persons responsible in the event of an incident.
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: It is based on Risk Assessment and Risk Management.

CD0125 — Hot work.question: ISM Code 采用哪种安全方式？
options: 基于风险评估和风险管理。
要求在每个阶段填写复杂的检查清单。
包含非常详细的程序，涵盖船上操作的方方面面。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 基于风险评估和风险管理。

CD0125 — Hot work.question: Before any hot work task can take place, what is required?
options: Careful assessment of all related hazards, and the probability of their occurrence, to determine the severity of the risks involved.
Only an order from the Master or Chief Engineer.
The completion of the record in the “Hot Work file”, so that the vessel will pass its audits.
A quick check of the intended hot work site to make sure everything seems safe.
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: Careful assessment of all related hazards, and the probability of their occurrence, to determine the severity of the risks involved.

CD0125 — Hot work.question: 开始任何高温作业之前，需要什么操作？
options: 仔细评估所有相关危险，以及发生危险的可能性，以确定所涉及危险的严重度。
仅获取船长或轮机长的命令。
完成“高温作业文件”中的记录，以便船舶不会在审核中出现问题。
快速检查高温作业现场，确保所有内容看起来都安全。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 仔细评估所有相关危险，以及发生危险的可能性，以确定所涉及危险的严重度。

CD0125 — Hot work.question: Which of the following is the definition of a “Risk Assessment”?
options: A thorough and careful analysis of what, in the range of operations, could cause harm, so that decisions can be made as to whether enough precautions have been taken, or whether more should be done to prevent harm.
A brief visual check of the work site carried out immediately before the work is started, to ensure that the area is safe and clean.
An investigation into the circumstances which have led to an incident, such as an explosion that occurred during a welding repair.
The full and detailed briefing of all team members involved in a work task, to ensure that everyone is aware of their roles and responsibilities.
