CD0125 — Hot work.answer: A thorough and careful analysis of what, in the range of operations, could cause harm, so that decisions can be made as to whether enough precautions have been taken, or whether more should be done to prevent harm.

CD0125 — Hot work.question: 以下哪个是“风险评估”的定义？
options: 关于操作范围内哪些内容会产生危害的完整仔细的分析，以便可以判断是否采取了足够的预防措施，或者是否需要其他操作来预防伤害。
在作业真正开始之前对作业现场进行简单的肉眼检查，确保区域安全清洁。
对导致过事故（如焊接维修期间的爆炸）的情况进行调查。
为作业任务涉及的所有团队成员进行完整详细的传达，确保每个人都了解其角色和责任。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 关于操作范围内哪些内容会产生危害的完整仔细的分析，以便可以判断是否采取了足够的预防措施，或者是否需要其他操作来预防伤害。

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
A hot work repair is to take place on a bracket in a forward fuel tank. The tank has been cleaned
and gas-freed but how should the heating coils in the tank be treated before that hot work begins?
options: They should be flushed or blown through with steam and then tested to ensure they are clear of hydrocarbons.
They should be continuously blown through with fresh air while the hot work repair is taking place.
They should be disconnected and removed from the tank.
They should be continuously blown through with inert gas while the hot work repair is taking place.
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: They should be flushed or blown through with steam and then tested to ensure they are clear of hydrocarbons.

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
要对船首燃油罐内的支架进行高温作业维修。罐体已经清洁并进行了无气体处理，
但在高温作业开始之前应该如何处理罐体内的加热线圈？
options: 应该冲刷或使用蒸汽吹扫，然后进行测试，确保没有碳氢化合物。
进行高温作业维修时应该使用新鲜空气持续吹扫。
应该将其断开并从罐体取下。
进行高温作业维修时应该使用惰性气体持续吹扫。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 应该冲刷或使用蒸汽吹扫，然后进行测试，确保没有碳氢化合物。

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
The ship is to carry out some steel replacement in and around the forecastle head, following storm damage.
Shoreside contractors are to be brought on board for the hot work. Why must the Risk Assessment for the intended work take special account of these contractors?
options: Because they will be exposed to hazards not normally encountered on shore and they may have little or no maritime experience.
Because port regulations require that any Risk Assessment requires contractors to be specifically noted.
Because SOLAS 1974 requires that special provision be made for shoreside contractors working on board vessels afloat.
Because such workers are classified as “high risk” under the port regulations.
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: Because they will be exposed to hazards not normally encountered on shore and they may have little or no maritime experience.

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
在暴风雨损坏之后，船只要在船头甲板中和周围进行一些钢件更换。
要让岸上承包商上船进行高温作业。为什么要进行的作业风险评估必须特别考虑这些承包商？
options: 因为他们会面临在岸上通常不会遇到的危险，并且可能没有海上经验或者经验很少。
因为港口法规要求任何风险评估均需特别注意承包商。
因为 SOLAS 1974 要求为在漂浮船舶执行船上作业的岸上承包商提供特殊条款。
因为此类工作人员在港口法规中归为“高风险”类别。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 因为他们会面临在岸上通常不会遇到的危险，并且可能没有海上经验或者经验很少。

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
When a ship is in dry-dock, which of the following primarily governs the management of all safety
matters and the actions of shipyard personnel on board the ship?
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: The shipyard SMS.

CD0125 — Hot work.question: 当船只位于干船坞中时，以下哪项主要管辖所有安全事项的管理和船上的船厂人员的行为？
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 船厂 SMS。

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
When a ship is in dry-dock, who will normally carry out the testing of the atmosphere prior to entry into
enclosed spaces and for hot work?
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: The Shipyard chemist

CD0125 — Hot work.question: 当船只在干船坞中时，通常由谁来执行进入密闭空间之前和高温作业的大气测试？
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 船厂化学人员

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
The ship is to carry out some repairs, including hot work, at a lay-by berth. Shoreside contractors are to be
brought in for some of this work. Why must the Risk Assessment for the intended work take special account of these contractors?
options: Because they will be exposed to hazards not normally encountered on shore and they may have little or no maritime experience
Because  port  regulations require that any Risk Assessment requires contractors to be specifically noted
Because SOLAS 1974 requires that special provision be made for shoreside contractors working on board vessels afloat
Because such workers are classified as “high risk” under the ISPS Code
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: Because they will be exposed to hazards not normally encountered on shore and they may have little or no maritime experience

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
船只要在等待泊位进行一些维修，包括高温作业。要让岸上承包商执行其中某些作业。
为什么要进行的作业风险评估必须特别考虑这些承包商？
options: 因为他们会面临在岸上通常不会遇到的危险，并且可能没有海上经验或者经验很少
因为港口法规要求任何风险评估均需特别注意承包商
因为 SOLAS 1974 要求为在漂浮船舶执行船上作业的岸上承包商提供特殊条款
因为此类工作人员在 ISPS Code 中归为“高风险”类别
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 因为他们会面临在岸上通常不会遇到的危险，并且可能没有海上经验或者经验很少

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
Who is responsible for ensuring that adequate arrangements are provided for contractors or work
gangs, temporarily employed on board, to understand and comply with all relevant safe working practices?
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: The Master.

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
Where appropriate, how might a contractor’s supervisor or foreman confirm his awareness of the hazards
and safety precautions required to reduce the risks to an acceptable level when undertaking a hot work task on board ship?
options: By signing the formal approval relevant to the work he, or his gang, are to perform.
By verbally stating to the Responsible Officer that he has understood what is required.
By explaining the procedures to the rest of the work gang.
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: By signing the formal approval relevant to the work he, or his gang, are to perform.

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
如何合适，承包商的监督人员或领班应如何确认其了解在船上执行高温作业时的危险，
以及将风险降低到可接受水平所需的安全预防措施？
options: 通过签署他或他的团队要执行作业的相关正式审批文件。
向负责官员口头声明他了解了所需操作。
通过向工作团队解释程序。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 通过签署他或他的团队要执行作业的相关正式审批文件。

CD0125 — Hot work.question: What is cold work?
options: Work which cannot create a source of ignition.
Work that creates a cold spark.
Work that will still create a spark in sub-zero temperatures.
Work which creates a spark by the contact of two unheated materials.
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: Work which cannot create a source of ignition.

CD0125 — Hot work.question: 什么是低温作业？
options: 在零度以下仍然会产生火花的作业。
通过接触两个非加热材料产生火花的作业。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 不会产生火源的作业。

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
Previous Safety Management Systems were compliance-based.  The ISM Code has a different approach.
On which of the following is it based?
options: The establishment of as many detailed procedures as possible, covering every operation and task on board.
The identification of persons responsible in the event of an incident.
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: Risk Assessment and Risk Management.

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
以前的安全管理体系是基于合规性的。而 ISM Code 则采用其他方式。
它基于以下哪项？
options: 尽可能多地制定详细程序，包含船上的每种操作和任务。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 风险评估和风险管理。

CD0125 — Hot work.question: In developing their Safety Management Systems, which of the following does the ISM Code specifically encourage companies to take into account?
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: Applicable industry publications and guidelines.

CD0125 — Hot work.question: 公司制定安全管理体系时，ISM Code 鼓励其考虑以下哪项？
options: 适用的行业出版物和指南。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 适用的行业出版物和指南。

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
The transfer and isolation of slops is a requirement in many hot work situations. Is there an alternative
to this requirement, that might apply in certain circumstances and, if so, what is it?
options: Yes - the slops can be removed from the vessel.
No - this is an absolute requirement and there is no alternative.
Yes - the tank containing the slops can be inerted – they do not have to be moved if this is done.
Yes – the tank containing the slops can be continuously ventilated during the hot work procedure – they do not have to be moved if this is done.
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: Yes - the slops can be removed from the vessel.

CD0125 — Hot work.question: 在很多高温作业情况下均要求转移和隔离污水。对于此要求是否具有适用于某些情况的备用方式，^M如果有，是什么？
options: 有 - 污水可以处理到船舶之外。
没有 - 这是绝对要求，没有备用方式。
有 - 盛装污水的罐体可以惰性处理 - 完成后无需处理。
有 - 盛装污水的罐体在高温作业期间可以持续通风 - 完成后无需处理。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 有 - 污水可以处理到船舶之外。

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
If hot work is to be undertaken on a catwalk support, at a height of 400mm above the deck and directly over
a cargo tank, to what equivalent standard should the safety measures be considered?
options: To those that would apply if the hot work was being carried out inside the tank directly below the hot work location.
To those applicable to a tank adjacent to the tank directly below the hot work location.
All such hot work tasks that take place at 300mm or more above the deck are subject to the same safety requirements.
There are no special measures required for hot work that is more than 400mm above the deck.
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: To those that would apply if the hot work was being carried out inside the tank directly below the hot work location.

CD0125 — Hot work.question: 如果要对高于甲板 400 毫米且直接位于货物罐之上的步道支撑进行高温作业，则应考虑与什么标准对等的安全措施？
options: 与在罐体内部进行高温作业的位置下面相同的标准。
与高温作业位置之下罐体的临近罐体相同的标准。
所有在甲板以上 300 毫米或更高位置进行的此类高温作业均为同样的安全要求。
对于高于甲板 400 毫米的高温作业无需特殊措施。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 与在罐体内部进行高温作业的位置下面相同的标准。

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
A damaged bracket in cargo tank 1 port is to be cut away and replaced. The vessel is at sea and is not inerted.
Although not loaded, there are some slops in cargo tank 1 starboard. What must happen to these slops before work can start?
options: The slops must be transferred to a non-adjacent tank, at least 30 metres from the location at which the hot work is taking place and securely isolated.
Tank 1 starboard should be securely sealed and water run continuously across the deck whilst the hot work repair is taking place.
Provided the tank lids are securely closed and all valves closed, it is not necessary to do anything with the slops.
The slops can remain in cargo tank 1 starboard but the tank must be isolated from both the Inert Gas main and the cargo piping system while the hot work is being carried out.
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: The slops must be transferred to a non-adjacent tank, at least 30 metres from the location at which the hot work is taking place and securely isolated.

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
左舷 1 号货物罐中的支架损坏，要进行切割和更换。船舶正在海上航行，未进行惰性处理。
尽管未装货，但右舷货物罐 1 中有一些污水。作业开始之前必须对这些污水进行什么操作？
options: 污水必须转移到非临近罐体内，并距高温作业位置至少 30 米且安全隔离。
进行高温作业维修时，右舷罐体 1 应紧密密封且在甲板上持续流水。
只要罐体铅盖紧固关闭且所有阀门关闭，则不需对污水进行任何操作。
进行高温作业时，污水应保存在右舷货物罐 1 中，但罐体必须与惰性气体主系统和货物管道系统隔开。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 污水必须转移到非临近罐体内，并距高温作业位置至少 30 米且安全隔离。

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
Is a cargo tank diagonally across the point at which longitudinal and transverse tank bulkheads meet
considered to be adjacent for the purposes of hot work requirements?
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: Yes.

CD0125 — Hot work.question: 如果货物罐对角线穿过罐体舱壁横向和纵向交叉点，是否将其视为高温作业要求的临近区域？
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 是。

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
Some broken railings are scheduled to be welded on the tank deck. The ship is empty and partly ballasted.
No cargo operations are taking place. Is it necessary to test the ballast tank adjacent to the hot work site for the presence of hydrocarbon vapours?
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: Yes.

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
计划对油罐甲板上的一些断裂的围栏进行焊接。船只为空载，只有部分压载。
未在进行货物操作。有必要对高温作业现场附近的压载罐进行测试看是否存在碳氢气体吗？
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 需要。

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
A hot work repair is to take place on a ladder in a cargo tank. How should pipelines that connect the tank to
other cargo spaces be treated before that hot work begins?
options: They should be flushed through with water, drained, vented and isolated from the compartment where hot work will take place.
It is not necessary to do anything special with the pipelines, as the repair is to a ladder.
They should be continuously blown through with fresh air while the hot work repair is taking place.
They should be disconnected and removed from the tank.
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: They should be flushed through with water, drained, vented and isolated from the compartment where hot work will take place.

CD0125 — Hot work.question: 要对货物罐内的梯子进行高温作业维修。开始高温作业之前应该如何处理将罐体与其他货物空间的管道？
options: 应用水冲刷、排空、通风，并与要进行高温作业的隔室隔离。
对梯子进行维修时，无需对管道进行任何特殊处理。
进行高温作业维修时应该使用新鲜空气持续吹扫。
应该将其断开并从罐体取下。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 应用水冲刷、排空、通风，并与要进行高温作业的隔室隔离。

CD0125 — Hot work.question: When is a tank, compartment or container considered to be gas free?
options: When sufficient fresh air has been introduced into it to lower the level of any flammable, toxic, or inert gas to that required for a specific purpose.
When sufficient fresh air has been introduced into it to raise the level of oxygen present to that necessary to sustain human life.
When sufficient inert gas has been introduced into it to restrict the possibility of combustion in the presence of a source of ignition.
When a Senior Officer has declared it to be so for the purposes of entry.
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: When sufficient fresh air has been introduced into it to lower the level of any flammable, toxic, or inert gas to that required for a specific purpose.

CD0125 — Hot work.question: 什么情况下会认为罐体、隔室或容器无气体？
options: 引入了足够的新鲜空气，使得任何可燃、有毒或惰性气体的浓度水平均降低到了特定目标（如罐体进入和高温作业）所需的浓度之下时。
引入了足够的新鲜空气，使得氧气提高到维持人员生命所需浓度时。
引入了足够的惰性气体，限制了存在火源是燃烧的可能性时。
当高级官员声明这样是为了进入时。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 引入了足够的新鲜空气，使得任何可燃、有毒或惰性气体的浓度水平均降低到了特定目标（如罐体进入和高温作业）所需的浓度之下时。

CD0125 — Hot work.question: Which of the following is the definition of the Lower Explosive Limit?
options: Where the concentration of a hydrocarbon gas in air is below that in which there is sufficient hydrocarbon to support and propagate combustion.
Where the concentration of a hydrocarbon gas in air is above that in which there is sufficient hydrogen peroxide to prevent combustion.
Where the concentration of an ionized gas in hydrogen is below that in which there is sufficient reagent to support and propagate combustion.
The lowest level in a cargo tank to which a potential source of ignition  (such as a light not contained in an explosive-proof casing) can safely be lowered without causing an explosion.
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: Where the concentration of a hydrocarbon gas in air is below that in which there is sufficient hydrocarbon to support and propagate combustion.

CD0125 — Hot work.question: 下面哪个是低燃爆限制的定义？
options: 低于足以支持和传播燃烧的空气中碳氢气体的浓度。
高于存在的过氧化氢足以防止燃烧的空气中碳氢气体的浓度。
低于试剂足以支持和传播燃烧的氢电离气体的浓度。
货物罐体内可以安全降低潜在火源（如未包含在防爆箱内的灯具）使其不会导致爆炸的最低液位。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 低于足以支持和传播燃烧的空气中碳氢气体的浓度。

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
Unless it is cleaned for hot work, at what minimum distance is a hot work repair permitted from the
bulkhead of a bunker tank?
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 500 millimetres.

CD0125 — Hot work.question: 除非进行清洁使其符合高温作业标准，否则最少离开燃油罐多远才允许进行高温作业维修？

A hot work repair is to take place on a ladder in a fuel bunker tank. How should pipelines connected to
the tank be treated before that hot work begins?
options: They should be flushed through with water, drained, vented and isolated from the compartment where hot work will take place.
It is not necessary to do anything special with the pipelines, as the repair is to a ladder.
They should be continuously blown through with fresh air while the hot work repair is taking place.
They should be disconnected and removed from the tank.
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: They should be flushed through with water, drained, vented and isolated from the compartment where hot work will take place.

CD0125 — Hot work.question: 要对燃油罐内的梯子进行高温作业维修。在高温作业开始之前应该如何处理罐体连接的管道？
options: 应用水冲刷、排空、通风，并与要进行高温作业的隔室隔离。
对梯子进行维修时，无需对管道进行任何特殊处理。
进行高温作业维修时应该使用新鲜空气持续吹扫。
应该将其断开并从罐体取下。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 应用水冲刷、排空、通风，并与要进行高温作业的隔室隔离。

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
If hot work is intended for a dedicated gas safe area on the poop deck, is it necessary to perform
a Risk Assessment?
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: Yes.

CD0125 — Hot work.question: 如果要在艉楼甲板上的专门气体安全区域进行高温作业，需要进行风险评估吗？
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 需要。

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
It is intended to perform a welding repair to a bracket on a bulkhead just outside the purifier room.
The bulkhead to the fuel oil settling tank is 640 mm away from the bracket. Can the repair take place?
options: Yes, provided a Risk Assessment has been done and all appropriate safety precautions have been taken.
No, unless the Settling Tank is cleaned to hot work standard and has been subject to an inspection and tests to verify that status.
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: Yes, provided a Risk Assessment has been done and all appropriate safety precautions have been taken.

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
要对净化室外部舱壁上的支架进行焊接维修。
燃油罐舱壁离支架 640 毫米。可以进行此次维修吗？
options: 可以，条件是要进行风险评估且采取了所有恰当的安全预防措施。
不可以，除非此类罐体已经清洁，符合高温作业标准，并且进行了检查和测试验证了此状态。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 可以，条件是要进行风险评估且采取了所有恰当的安全预防措施。

CD0125 — Hot work.question: Where on board should be considered as the best location for hot work?
options: A designated space, such as the engine room workshop.
A dedicated area, such as behind the accommodation block.
At the actual location of the required repair.
Inside a gas free cargo tank.
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: A designated space, such as the engine room workshop.

CD0125 — Hot work.question: 船上什么位置应视为高温作业的最佳位置？
options: 机械空间内的任何地方。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 指定空间，如机房车间。

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
Prior to hot work taking place, what level should be measured in the atmosphere in a space
(not a designated space), when tested for concentration of a hydrocarbon gas in air?
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: Less than 1% LFL.

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
进行高温作业之前，测试空气中碳氢气体的浓度时，空间（非指定空间）内空气的测量水平
应为多少？
options: 500 mm / m3 浓度的碳氢气体。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 小于 1% LFL。

CD0125 — Hot work.question:
In view of the potential for delayed fires resulting from the use of burning or welding apparatus,
what should be done in areas considered at risk?
options: Checks should also be continued for at least two hours after the work has been completed.
The areas should be filled with a light water mist.
Nothing further is required once the hot work is completed and the equipment has been withdrawn.
The Chief Engineer should be notified.
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: Checks should also be continued for at least two hours after the work has been completed.

CD0125 — Hot work.question: 对于使用燃烧或焊接设备导致的延迟火灾的可能性，对认为有危险的区域应进行什么操作？
options: 作业完成之后至少两小时进行持续检查。
这些区域应该喷洒轻度水雾。
高温作业完成之后无需进一步操作，设备已经收回。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 作业完成之后至少两小时进行持续检查。

CD0125 — Hot work.question: What is the “Permit to Work” designed to do?
options: Lead the operator through an appropriate process in a logical, detailed and responsible manner and ensure that all safety concerns raised by the risk assessment are satisfactorily addressed.
It is completed by the Responsible Person, so that the job can be started as soon as possible.
Provide a full and detailed record of a work task, including persons involved, the location, dates, times and a description of the work procedure, only for auditing purposes.
Provide proof that an adequate risk assessment has been carried out.
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: Lead the operator through an appropriate process in a logical, detailed and responsible manner and ensure that all safety concerns raised by the risk assessment are satisfactorily addressed.

CD0125 — Hot work.question: “作业许可证”的用途是什么？
options: 引导操作人员以逻辑性、详细和负责的方式完成一个恰当的过程，确保风险评估引发的所有安全顾虑均得以满意解决。
由负责人员完成，这样作业就可以尽快开始了。
提供完整详细的作业记录，包括涉及人员、位置、日期、时间和作业程序说明，仅用于审核目的。
提供证据证明进行了足够的风险评估。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 引导操作人员以逻辑性、详细和负责的方式完成一个恰当的过程，确保风险评估引发的所有安全顾虑均得以满意解决。

CD0125 — Hot work.question: What is required before any hot work task can be commenced on board?
options: Careful assessment of all related hazards, and the probability of their occurrence, to determine the severity of the risks involved.
Only an order from a senior officer.
The completion of a form in the “Hot Work file”, so that the vessel will not fail an audit.
A quick visual check around to make sure everything seems safe.
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: Careful assessment of all related hazards, and the probability of their occurrence, to determine the severity of the risks involved.

CD0125 — Hot work.question: 在船上开始任何高温作业之前需要什么？
options: 仔细评估所有相关危险，以及发生危险的可能性，以确定所涉及危险的严重度。
完成“高温作业文件”中的表格，以便船舶不会在审核中出现问题。
快速肉眼检查，确保所有内容看起来都安全。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 仔细评估所有相关危险，以及发生危险的可能性，以确定所涉及危险的严重度。

CD0125 — Hot work.question: Which of the following defines a “Risk Assessment”?
options: A thorough and careful analysis of what, in the range of operations, could cause harm, so that decisions can be made as to whether enough precautions have been taken, or whether more should be done to prevent harm.

A brief visual check of the work site and immediate surrounding area, carried out immediately before the commencement of work, to ensure that the area is safe and all equipment appears to be functioning correctly.
A full and detailed investigation into the circumstances which have led to an incident, such as a fire following a hot work repair.

The completion and posting of a written form, indicating the type of work, location, date and validity and bearing the signatures of the Master, Senior Officer supervising the task and the person carrying out the task.
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: A thorough and careful analysis of what, in the range of operations, could cause harm, so that decisions can be made as to whether enough precautions have been taken, or whether more should be done to prevent harm.

CD0125 — Hot work.question: 以下哪个是“风险评估”的定义？
options: 关于操作范围内哪些内容会产生危害的完整仔细的分析，以便可以判断是否采取了足够的预防措施，或者是否需要其他操作来预防伤害。
在作业真正开始之前对作业现场和附近四周进行简单的肉眼检查，确保区域安全，所有设备看起来均运行正常。
对导致过事故（如高温作业维修之后的火灾）的情况进行完整详细的调查。
书面表格的完成和张贴，其中表明作业类型、位置、日期和有效性，并且带有船长、监督该任务的高级官员和执行该任务的人员的签名。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 关于操作范围内哪些内容会产生危害的完整仔细的分析，以便可以判断是否采取了足够的预防措施，或者是否需要其他操作来预防伤害。

CD0125 — Hot work.question: How should portable lights be used when illuminating an area of work?
options: They should be clamped or otherwise secured in position, with leads kept clear of the working area.
They should be held by hand
They should be loosely suspended by a line, with the supply lead across the work area
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: They should be clamped or otherwise secured in position, with leads kept clear of the working area.

CD0125 — Hot work.question: 对作业区域进行照明时，应该如何使用移动灯具？
options: 应该夹住或以其他方式固定，并且电线要离开作业区域。
应该用一根电线进行松散悬挂，并且电源线穿过作业区域。
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 应该夹住或以其他方式固定，并且电线要离开作业区域。

CD0125 — Hot work.question: What should be put on the top of a gas cylinder when it is to be moved onto the ships’ maindeck for hot work?
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: The protective cap

CD0125 — Hot work.question: 将气瓶移到船只的主甲板上进行高温作业时，应在气瓶上放置什么？
options: 红色或“可见度较高”的标志
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 保护盖

CD0125 — Hot work.question: What could be an indication of decomposing Acetylene in a gas cylinder?
options: A rise in temperature in the cylinder
A hissing sound at the blowpipe tip
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: A rise in temperature in the cylinder

CD0125 — Hot work.question: 什么情况表明气瓶中的乙炔已经分解？
options: 管道出口处发出滋滋声
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 气瓶温度升高

CD0125 — Hot work.question: What type of boiler-suit or coveralls should be worn by a person carrying out a hot work task?
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: Long-sleeved, cotton.

CD0125 — Hot work.question: 进行高温作业的人员应该穿戴什么类型的连身工作服？
CD0125 — Hot work.answer: 长袖棉质。

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: To ensure an enclosed space entry operation continues in a safe manner, which of the following conditions should be met? Select the ONE best answer.
options: Those who enter the space and also the attendant should remain alert and watch for any changes in circumstances that may render the space unsafe.
The Responsible Person should issue a permit with much longer than enough approval time to allow the planned task to be completed.
The crewmembers that enter the space should maintain verbal contact with each other continuously.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: Those who enter the space and also the attendant should remain alert and watch for any changes in circumstances that may render the space unsafe.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: An emergency has occurred in an enclosed space.  Which ONE of the following statements is correct?
options: The attendant should not, under any circumstances, enter the space alone or before the rest of the rescue team has arrived.
The attendant should immediately enter the enclosed space to assist those inside, because time is critical.
The attendant should shout the pre-arranged alarm message into the radio, then enter the enclosed space, because the rescue team will be there as soon as they are assembled.
The attendant should immediately run to the bridge or control room, raise the alarm and then wait there until the Master arrives to take charge.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: The attendant should not, under any circumstances, enter the space alone or before the rest of the rescue team has arrived.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: If the attendant hears a low level audible alarm whistle from a self-contained breathing apparatus coming from inside an enclosed space, what should they do? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: Look for the user moving towards the exit and assist them once they emerge.
Take another fully-charged set inside for the user.
Lower a full cylinder into the space for the user and wait to pull the empty one out, so it can be re-charged
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: Look for the user moving towards the exit and assist them once they emerge.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: Entry into an unsafe or suspect atmosphere should be considered as what kind of event? Select the ONE correct answer.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: Extraordinary.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: If the compressor feeding an air-line breathing apparatus fails and the emergency supply is engaged, what should the wearer immediately do? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: Stop work and immediately exit the space.
Finish the assigned work as quickly as possible.
Take a deep breath, remove the face mask and climb out of the space.
Check the pressure gauge and estimate how much longer they can remain inside the space.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: Stop work and immediately exit the space.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: What can be used to ensure that no items relevant to the task have been missed during the planning stage? Select the ONE best answer.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: A checklist.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: Whose overall duty is it, to ensure that the plan for entry into an enclosed space is followed? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: The senior rating of the team that will be doing the work inside the space
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: The Responsible Person.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: If the conditions at the exact job location within an enclosed space cannot be properly assessed, what should be done? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: Assessment and planning should be done to allow an initial entry and then further planning will be done once the necessary information has been obtained from inside the space.
Assessment and planning should be done as far as is possible and those entering the space should then use their judgement when deciding whether to continue with the job straight away.
The Responsible Person should just enter the space and do a quick risk assessment, so that he can present all the necessary information to the planning team.
Similar information should be drawn from previous enclosed space operations, in order to complete the planning beforehand in one meeting.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: Assessment and planning should be done to allow an initial entry and then further planning will be done once the necessary information has been obtained from inside the space.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: When it is required to gas free a cargo tank on an oil tanker after washing, the space is first purged down with inert gas to reduce the hydrocarbon content to 2% or less by volume.  Why is this done? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: So that, during subsequent gas freeing, no part of the tank atmosphere is brought within the flammable range.
Because gas freeing will then not take so long.
Because the toxic vapours cannot be removed by gas freeing alone.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: So that, during subsequent gas freeing, no part of the tank atmosphere is brought within the flammable range.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: What should be the status of the ventilation during testing of the atmosphere in an enclosed space prior to entry? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: It should have been stopped about 10 minutes before testing and remain stopped until testing is complete.
It should be running at full pressure throughout testing.
It should have been stopped around 1 hour before testing and remain stopped until testing is complete.
The lids should be closed over and the ventilator or pressure/vacuum valve closed, so as to create an overpressure within the space.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: It should have been stopped about 10 minutes before testing and remain stopped until testing is complete.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: In what parts of an enclosed space should the atmosphere be tested prior to entry? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: At multiple levels and in different sections of the space, to increase the possibility of detecting pockets of gas that might remain in less well ventilated areas.
At the bottom of the space, immediately below the access hatch, because toxic vapours are all heavier than air and will sink to the bottom.
At the top of the space, immediately inside the access hatch, because toxic vapours are all lighter than air and will rise to the top.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: At multiple levels and in different sections of the space, to increase the possibility of detecting pockets of gas that might remain in less well ventilated areas.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: Who can test the atmosphere in an enclosed space for the purposes of authorising entry? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: Only a person trained in the use of the equipment and listed as an Approved Operator (or similar) under a ship's SMS.
Anyone who can operate the test equipment and is available at the time entry is required.
Only the person who will be entering the space first.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: Only a person trained in the use of the equipment and listed as an Approved Operator (or similar) under a ship's SMS.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: Can a combustible gas detector be used to detect a gas other than the standard gas on which it is calibrated?  Select the ONE best answer.
options: Yes, but only for a limited range of similar gases and reference must be made to the calibration curves supplied with the meter.
No, but if fitted with a special additional filter, certain non-toxic gases may register and readings may be interpolated using the vapour density of the gas.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: Yes, but only for a limited range of similar gases and reference must be made to the calibration curves supplied with the meter.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: Which ONE of the following statements is correct?
options: Personal monitors only provide a warning against oxygen deficiency and hydrocarbon concentrations when there is a change in conditions in the immediate vicinity of the wearer.
Personal monitors provide a warning against oxygen deficiency and hydrocarbon concentrations throughout the whole of an enclosed space.
Personal monitors are an acceptable alternative to a remote analyser in determining if an enclosed space is safe to enter in an unprotected condition.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: Personal monitors only provide a warning against oxygen deficiency and hydrocarbon concentrations when there is a change in conditions in the immediate vicinity of the wearer.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: Which instrument gives readouts of gas concentration in terms of the Lower Flammable Limit? Select the ONE correct answer.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: A combustible gas indicator.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: According to IMO requirements, what is the minimum steady reading that must be obtained on an oxygen analyser before unprotected entry into an enclosed space can be permitted? Select the ONE correct answer.
Can an explosimeter detect the presence of a flammable vapour in a space filled with inert gas?  Select the ONE best answer.
options: Some types can, and some types cannot. So this has to be checked.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: Some types can, and some types cannot. So this has to be checked.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: A storeroom is normally continuously ventilated but it suffers an electrical failure and the ventilation fan has been stopped for three hours.  How would you now consider that storeroom? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: As dangerous.  It must be treated as an enclosed space for the purpose of entry procedures.
It should be alright for entry.  (Three hours is not that long)
There is no problem.  It is only a storeroom.
So long as the electrical failure has been rectified, there is no outstanding problem and entry is permitted.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: As dangerous.  It must be treated as an enclosed space for the purpose of entry procedures.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: In relation to entry into an enclosed space, what is “approved equipment”? Select the ONE best answer.
options: Equipment of a design tested and approved by an appropriate authority for use in a specified hazardous environment.
Equipment issued with the approval and authority of the Chief Officer.
Monitors and other test equipment that have been examined and tested within the previous three months.
Apparatus that has been supplied by an approved safety company.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: Equipment of a design tested and approved by an appropriate authority for use in a specified hazardous environment.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: According to this module, what is the normal oxygen content (by volume) in fresh air? Select the ONE correct answer.
For enclosed space entry, what is the definition of a “Responsible Person”? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: A person authorized to permit entry into an enclosed space and having sufficient knowledge of the procedures to be established and complied with on board, in order to ensure that the space is safe for entry.

A Junior Officer assisting the vessel’s Safety Officer by reporting all activity related to a specific task within an enclosed space, having been briefed with the required information for that purpose.

A Superintendent contracted by the company to organise all safety-related activities on board the ship, having received the required specialised training and possessing the necessary qualifications to allow him to accurately communicate information relating to enclosed space entry to the company Operations Manager.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: A person authorized to permit entry into an enclosed space and having sufficient knowledge of the procedures to be established and complied with on board, in order to ensure that the space is safe for entry.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: What is the first step in any potentially hazardous work task on board? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: Filling out the permits to work.
Taking equipment required for the job into the space.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: Risk assessment.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: What is the biggest hazard associated with entry into an enclosed space? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: The Competent Person’s signature missing from the entry permit.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: The potentially harmful atmosphere inside.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: How do the IMO define an enclosed space? Select the ONE best answer.
options: A space with limited openings for entry and exit, or inadequate ventilation or that is not designed for continuous worker occupancy.

A space or void enclosed by bulkheads and an overhead closure which, by its design and limited number of access points, reduces the hazard exposure of any person entering, or working within that space.

A space with limited access, subject to continuous ventilation, which is routinely and regularly entered but for which a permit to work has been issued under the International Safety Management System.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: A space with limited openings for entry and exit, or inadequate ventilation or that is not designed for continuous worker occupancy.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: Why is it necessary to “tally”, or check personnel as they exit an enclosed space? Select the ONE best answer.
options: To see if anyone is missing and therefore still inside the space.
To record that they have been involved in that task for work records and overtime sheets.
Because that is one of the duties of the attendant as listed in the Chief Officer’s instructions.
To ensure that the right number of flashlights, test meters and other safety items is returned after use.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: To see if anyone is missing and therefore still inside the space.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: Why must a check be made to ensure that all rags and other small items of gear have been removed from an enclosed space on completion? Select the ONE best answer.
options: Because, if missed, they may later be drawn into a pump or valve and damage or block it with serious consequences.
Because the Boatswain is responsible for ensuring that all small gear is returned after use.
Because it is in the Chief Officer’s instructions.
Because if anything like that is found during tank or hold inspection, the surveyor might report it.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: Because, if missed, they may later be drawn into a pump or valve and damage or block it with serious consequences.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: If a lifeline is to be used, which one of the following is an essential feature? Select the ONE best answer.
options: That it can be easily detached by the wearer, in the event that it becomes tangled.
That it is long enough to go to the bottom of the enclosed space and back up again.
That it is strong enough to support the weight of the wearer plus all the equipment in use inside the space.
That it is of a high visibility colour.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: That it can be easily detached by the wearer, in the event that it becomes tangled.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: How is the attendant assigned to enclosed space entry to be employed?  Select the ONE correct answer.
options: The attendant must not be assigned to other duties and must remain at the entrance to the space while it is occupied.
Provided they pass on the duties to someone else, they can go elsewhere and it is not necessary to tell anyone that the attendant has changed.
If a Junior Officer tells him to do a new job somewhere else and that it is OK to leave, he must follow the new instructions.
Provided the attendant has radio contact with the persons inside the enclosed space, it is alright to leave the access and perform duties elsewhere.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: The attendant must not be assigned to other duties and must remain at the entrance to the space while it is occupied.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: Which one of the following substances is toxic and is released from vegetable, fish and animal oils during interaction with sea water?  Select the ONE correct answer.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: Hydrogen sulphide.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: Some cargoes are “carcinogenic”.  What does this mean? Select the ONE correct answer.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: They can generate cancer.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: You are in charge of a team that must enter an enclosed space to rescue a man who has collapsed inside.  What is your main priority? Select the one best answer.
options: To ensure that adequate precautions have been taken to protect the rescue team, thereby preventing additional casualties.
To get to the casualty as soon as possible and evacuate them to fresh air, even if it means entering without full safety equipment.
To ensure an assistant records all times and other details for the purposes of completing the report required under the Safety Management System.
To collect and prepare an appropriate range of safety equipment at the entrance to the space, so that whatever is needed can be passed inside without further delay.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: To ensure that adequate precautions have been taken to protect the rescue team, thereby preventing additional casualties.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: You are the Responsible Person for a cleaning job in a cargo tank.  Why must you check around inside the space once cleaning is completed?  Select the ONE best answer.
options: To check that no rags, flashlights, lines, clothing or other equipment has been left inside, where it could later be drawn into a pump or valve and damage or block it with serious consequences.
Because I have to make sure that all small gear that has been used in the operation is returned to the locker.
Because if anything like that is found during tank or hold inspection, the surveyor might report it.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: To check that no rags, flashlights, lines, clothing or other equipment has been left inside, where it could later be drawn into a pump or valve and damage or block it with serious consequences.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: Some cargoes are “carcinogenic”.  What does this mean? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: They can induce indigestion and nausea.
They will trigger an allergic reaction to inorganic cargo vapours.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: They can generate cancer.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: When is an enclosed space considered safe and fit for unprotected entry? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: Only when it has been tested and certified as “gas free” by a competent person and approved for entry.
When cleaning has finished and the compartment has been rinsed with fresh water.
When it smells OK from the deck hatch.
When somebody else has already gone inside without a gas mask.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: Only when it has been tested and certified as “gas free” by a competent person and approved for entry.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: What is the normal oxygen content in fresh air (by volume)? Select the ONE correct answer.

A tank that contained a cargo of vegetable oil has been rough-washed with salt water.  It has then been allowed to lie untouched for two days.  Which of the following toxic substances is likely to have been released into the atmosphere within the tank over this period?  Select the ONE correct answer.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: Hydrogen sulphide.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: You are to test the atmosphere in a tank prior to entry for cleaning and maintenance purposes.  Where will you take the readings?  Select the ONE correct answer.
options: At multiple levels and in different sections of the space, through the various lids and vents, to increase the possibility of detecting pockets of gas that might remain in less well ventilated areas.

At the bottom of the space, immediately below the access hatch, because toxic vapours are all heavier than air and will sink to the bottom and this is the most likely location for registering any dangerous readings.

At the top of the space, immediately inside the access hatch, because toxic vapours are all lighter than air and will rise to the top and this is the most likely location for registering any dangerous readings.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: At multiple levels and in different sections of the space, through the various lids and vents, to increase the possibility of detecting pockets of gas that might remain in less well ventilated areas.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: Whose overall duty is it, to ensure that the plan for entry into an enclosed space is followed? Select the ONE best answer.
options: The person in charge of the team that will enter the space
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: The Responsible Person.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: A cleaning and repair job is to be done in a tank.  The tank is heavily framed, of an awkward shape, with several distinct sections and built over and around a number of other storage tanks. Access lids and ventilation pipes are all at the forward end of the tank. How can it be ensured that the conditions in the area of the repair are fully checked?  Select the ONE correct answer.
options: Assess and plan for an initial entry, carry out further assessment within the space and then plan the entry for the repair on the basis of the additional information obtained.
Assess and plan as far as possible and then brief those entering the space for the repair to use their judgement when they get to the after end of the tank.
Enter the tank and take a quick look round to get an overall picture of the general conditions inside the space and plan the subsequent entry and repair job on that basis.
Look back in the records and find a report from a similar repair in the past.  If it was more-or-less the same situation, base all planning on that.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: Assess and plan for an initial entry, carry out further assessment within the space and then plan the entry for the repair on the basis of the additional information obtained.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: Which ONE of the following is a correct statement?
options: Personal monitors only provide a warning against oxygen deficiency and hydrocarbon concentrations when there is a change in conditions in the immediate vicinity of the wearer.
Personal monitors provide a warning against oxygen deficiency and hydrocarbon concentrations throughout an enclosed space in which the wearer is working.
Personal monitors are an acceptable alternative to a remote analyser in determining if an enclosed space is safe to enter in an unprotected condition.

Personal monitors are now replacing remote reading meters as the standard equipment for determining the oxygen deficiency and hydrocarbon concentration within the atmospheres contained in enclosed spaces prior to entry.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: Personal monitors only provide a warning against oxygen deficiency and hydrocarbon concentrations when there is a change in conditions in the immediate vicinity of the wearer.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: A forecastle store containing paint and chemicals is normally continuously ventilated but the area has suffered an electrical failure and the ventilation fan has been stopped overnight.  How would you now consider that storeroom? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: As dangerous. It must be treated as an enclosed space for the purpose of entry procedures.
It should be alright for entry but the door should be left open for a few minutes before anyone enters.
There is no problem. It is only a storeroom and has been regularly used up until last night.
So long as the electrical fault has been corrected, it will be OK to enter without additional precautions.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: As dangerous. It must be treated as an enclosed space for the purpose of entry procedures.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: In relation to entry into an enclosed space, what is “approved equipment”? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: Equipment of a design tested and approved by an appropriate authority for use in a specified hazardous environment.
Filter masks and replacement cartridges issued directly by the Chief Officer.
Monitors and gas test equipment that have been examined and tested within the previous three months.
Apparatus that has been supplied by an approved safety company.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: Equipment of a design tested and approved by an appropriate authority for use in a specified hazardous environment.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: Who is permitted to test the atmosphere in an enclosed space for the purposes of authorising entry? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: Only a person trained in the use of the equipment and listed as an Approved Operator.
Anyone who can operate the test equipment and is available at the time entry is required.
Only the person who will be entering the space first.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: Only a person trained in the use of the equipment and listed as an Approved Operator.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: What does the term “lock out and tag out” refer to? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: The securing and labelling of equipment against inadvertent use.
Restrictions on personnel against entering certain compartments and spaces on the vessel without the appropriate personal security tag.
The removal of locking devices and withdrawal of advisory notices from valves and switches that had earlier been secured against inadvertent use during an enclosed space entry operation.
The part of a risk analysis where the Competent Person identifies the valves and switches to be secured by placing a red tag on them.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: The securing and labelling of equipment against inadvertent use.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: You are to test the atmosphere in a tank prior to entry. If at all, how will you adjust the ventilation?  Select the ONE correct answer.
options: I will stop it about 10 minutes before testing and not re-start it until testing is complete.
I will have it running at as close to full pressure as possible throughout testing.
I will reduce it to minimum around 30 minutes before testing and only speed it up again once testing is complete.
I will close over all the lids and secure the ventilator or pressure/vacuum valve closed, so as to create an overpressure within the space.
I will just test it as I find it, without touching any ventilation that is running.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: I will stop it about 10 minutes before testing and not re-start it until testing is complete.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: You are to be part of a two-man team to enter an enclosed lower deck in the forecastle head.  You are to wear self-contained breathing apparatus and the Responsible Person has decided that a lifeline is to be used.  What must you ensure you can do with that lifeline? Select the ONE best answer.
options: That I can easily detach it, if it becomes tangled on the steps or other fittings in the forecastle.

I should estimate the distance that the team is to enter the space and ensure that we carry twice that amount of line in with us, so that if it becomes tangled at the bottom, we can still get back to the entrance.
I should check the label on the lifeline to ensure that the breaking strain is adequate to support the weight of my colleague, together with the breathing apparatus and other equipment he is wearing.
I should verify that the colour coding on the end of the lifeline conforms to the requirements of the company Safety Management System, indicating that it is suitable for use in a storeroom area.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: That I can easily detach it, if it becomes tangled on the steps or other fittings in the forecastle.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: Which of the following is the definition of a gas free compartment? Select the ONE best answer.
options: One that is in a suitable and safe condition, such that sufficient fresh air has been introduced into it to lower the level of any flammable, toxic or inert gas to that required for a specified purpose.

One that is listed on a permit which confirms that the atmosphere contained therein has flammability, toxicity and oxygen readings above the corresponding minimum recommended levels listed in the Safety Management System.
One that is believed to be in an acceptable condition suitable for an intended task, based on the visual inspection by a designated responsible person.
One which the Chief Officer has verbally confirmed to be safe for entry based on his experience and knowledge.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: One that is in a suitable and safe condition, such that sufficient fresh air has been introduced into it to lower the level of any flammable, toxic or inert gas to that required for a specified purpose.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: For enclosed space entry, which one of the following describes the “Responsible Person”? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: A person authorised to permit entry into an enclosed space and having sufficient knowledge of the procedures to be established and complied with on board, in order to ensure that the space is safe for entry.
A Junior Officer appointed by the Safety Officer to report all activity related to a specific task within an enclosed space, having the required understanding and knowledge for that purpose.

A Superintendent appointed by the company to oversee all safety-related activities on board the ship, capable of delivering specialised training and empowering him to report information relating to enclosed space entry to the management office.
A Senior Officer, appointed by the Master, who can further delegate responsibility for enclosed space entry to a selected Junior Officer or Rating.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: A person authorised to permit entry into an enclosed space and having sufficient knowledge of the procedures to be established and complied with on board, in order to ensure that the space is safe for entry.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: You are assigned as the attendant at the entrance to 3 starboard double bottom ballast tank, inside which the Chief Officer and Cadet are carrying out an inspection.  What do you understand you are permitted to do? Select the ONE best answer.
options: I cannot be assigned to other duties while I am attendant and must remain at the entrance to the space while it is occupied.
I must stay at the entrance until it is time for lunch.

I was working in the starboard lifeboat before the Chief Officer called me for the attendant’s duty.  If the 3rd Officer tells me to go back to the starboard lifeboat, then I should go, because that was my original job for the day.
Provided I have radio contact with the Cadet inside the tank, it is alright to leave the entrance and carry on working elsewhere on the deck.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: I cannot be assigned to other duties while I am attendant and must remain at the entrance to the space while it is occupied.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: You are the designated attendant at the top of a tank.  Three crew members are inside overhauling a faulty pump.  You see one man collapse and hear the other two shouting.  What are you going to do?  Select the ONE correct answer.
options: I will sound the alarm immediately, report the situation to the Responsible Person and assist the rescue team once they have arrived.
I will immediately put a breathing apparatus on and go inside the space and see if I can help the collapsed man.
I will go inside and pull the collapsed man out, because getting him into fresh air quickly could be critical.
I will sound the alarm, then enter the enclosed space and supervise preparations to evacuate the casualty, because the rescue team will bring the stretcher as soon as they are assembled.
I will immediately run to the bridge, raise the alarm and then wait there until the Master arrives to take charge.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: I will sound the alarm immediately, report the situation to the Responsible Person and assist the rescue team once they have arrived.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: What is the first step in any potentially hazardous work task on board. Select the ONE correct answer.
options: Filling out the permits to work.
Taking equipment required for the job into the space.
A planning meeting to discuss how to carry out the repair.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: Risk assessment.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: You are the attendant at the entrance to an enclosed cargo hold.  Why must you  “tally”, or check the crew off as they exit the space after finishing their work inside? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: To see if anyone is missing and therefore still inside the space.
To record the names for the Chief Officer’s work records and overtime sheets.
Because the Chief Officer’s instructions always list that as one of the duties of the attendant.
Because the attendant is responsible for all the equipment inside the hold and I need to know the number of flashlights, personal meters and safety helmets that have been used.
Because the attendant is the responsible person for a hold entry and should check his squad are all present and correct before he dismisses them.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: To see if anyone is missing and therefore still inside the space.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: Can a combustible gas detector be used to detect a gas other than the standard gas on which it is calibrated?  Select the ONE best answer.
options: Yes, but only for a limited range of similar gases and reference must be made to the calibration curves supplied with the meter.
Yes, but the operator should be aware that toxic gases with a vapour density of greater than 1.2 may produce erroneous readings.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: Yes, but only for a limited range of similar gases and reference must be made to the calibration curves supplied with the meter.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: According to IMO requirements, what is the minimum steady reading that must be obtained on an oxygen analyser before unprotected entry into an enclosed space can be permitted? Select the ONE correct answer.
What is the main hazard associated with entry into an enclosed space? Select the ONE best answer.
options: The possible loss of communication with those outside the space.
Unsafe access arrangements that could lead to a slip, trip or fall.
The Responsible Person’s signature missing from the entry permit.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: The potentially hazardous atmosphere inside.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: Which one of the following is an acceptable definition of an enclosed space? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: A space which has  limited openings for entry and exit, or inadequate ventilation or is not designed for continuous worker occupancy
A space or void enclosed by bulkheads and an overhead which, by its design and  access points, reduces the hazard exposure of any person entering, or working within that space.
Any space which is enclosed by bulkheads and decks.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: A space which has  limited openings for entry and exit, or inadequate ventilation or is not designed for continuous worker occupancy

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: You are to enter an enclosed space as part of a small team to undertake some cleaning.  How will you ensure that the operation continues in a safe manner?  Select the ONE correct answer.
options: All of us entering the space, as well as the attendant at the entrance, must remain alert and watch for any changes in circumstances that may render the space unsafe.
We must check the Enclosed Space Entry permit to see that the Responsible Person has approved the space for a long enough period of time to allow us to complete the cleaning.
We should talk to each other the whole time, so that we will always know that everyone is OK.
One team member should be assigned to perform attendant duties immediately inside the space.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: All of us entering the space, as well as the attendant at the entrance, must remain alert and watch for any changes in circumstances that may render the space unsafe.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: Breathing apparatus should be inspected and tested periodically, as per the company maintenance schedule.  When else should it be tested for correct operation? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: 2-4 days prior to arrival in port.
When it has been in use in an enclosed space for more than 1 hour.
When it has been in use for any routine or emergency task where it may have been submerged in water or exposed to water spray.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: Before and after use.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: What are the employer’s legal obligations in respect of the provision of training on entry into enclosed spaces?  Select the ONE correct answer.
options: They must provide the necessary training, instruction and information to employees, in order to ensure that the regulations pertaining to entry into enclosed spaces are complied with.
They must provide training, instruction and information on entry into enclosed and confined spaces only if a request comes from the Safety Committee of a ship through the Master.
They must provide general safety manuals, CD’s and videos that could include some basic guidelines on entry into enclosed spaces.
The Employer is not actually legally required to provide any training at all.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: They must provide the necessary training, instruction and information to employees, in order to ensure that the regulations pertaining to entry into enclosed spaces are complied with.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: You are assisting outside an enclosed space.  A maintenance crew are inside and are using air-line breathing apparatus, supplied from a compressor located on deck close to the manhole cover access.  The compressor has an emergency supply in a cylinder connected via a manifold.  The compressor suddenly stops.  You switch over to the emergency supply straight away, but what should the team inside the space do?  Select the ONE correct answer.
options: They should immediately stop work and exit the space.
They should finish their assigned work as quickly as possible.
Each person inside should take a deep breath, remove their face mask and make their way to the exit.
They should check the local pressure gauge and estimate how much longer they can remain inside the space.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: They should immediately stop work and exit the space.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: You are the attendant at the entrance hatch to a tank where three men, wearing self-contained breathing apparatus, are working inside.  You hear the low level audible alarm whistle from one of the sets.  What are you going to do? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: Look for the user moving immediately towards the exit and assist them once they emerge.
Try and establish which set it is that is sounding the alarm, by shouting to, or otherwise communicating with, those inside.
Take another fully-charged set inside for the user.
Lower a full cylinder into the space for the user and wait to pull the empty one out, so it can be re-charged
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: Look for the user moving immediately towards the exit and assist them once they emerge.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: “A person appointed by the Master, or by the company, to take charge of an operation, such as entry into an enclosed space”^M^MThis is the definition of which of the following?  Select the ONE best answer.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: A “Responsible Person”.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: A “Competent Person” should have which of the following?
options: Sufficient theoretical knowledge and practical experience to make an informed assessment of the likelihood of a dangerous atmosphere being present or subsequently arising in the space.
Minimum qualifications as a Junior Deck Officer, with additional attendance at an approved safety course and experience of at least three enclosed space entry operations.
Seagoing experience appropriate to the vessel’s trading pattern and experience ashore as a superintendent, safety inspector, dockyard manager or repair specialist.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: Sufficient theoretical knowledge and practical experience to make an informed assessment of the likelihood of a dangerous atmosphere being present or subsequently arising in the space.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: Where there is minimal risk to the life or health of a person entering an enclosed space, what type of procedures will be initiated and followed? Select the ONE best answer
options: Further procedures and certain additional precautions that will continue to monitor and safeguard personnel.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: Routine safety and documentation procedures.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: In respect of training on entry into enclosed spaces, which of the following is the employer required to do? Select the ONE best answer.
options: Provide any necessary training, instruction and information to employees in order to ensure that the regulations pertaining to entry into enclosed spaces are complied with.
Provide training, instruction and information on entry into enclosed spaces only if requested by the employee.
Provide general safety manuals, CD’s and videos that may include some basic guidelines on entry into enclosed spaces.
The Employer is not required to provide any training at all.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: Provide any necessary training, instruction and information to employees in order to ensure that the regulations pertaining to entry into enclosed spaces are complied with.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: Assessment has revealed that the atmosphere in an enclosed space is unsafe but immediate entry is considered necessary.  What should those who enter the space be wearing? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: Nothing additional, but they should minimize their time inside.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: Breathing Apparatus.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: What should be the main priority of those who enter an enclosed space to carry out a rescue? Select the ONE best answer.
options: Ensure that adequate precautions have been taken to protect the rescue team, thereby preventing additional casualties.
Get to the casualty as soon as possible and evacuate them to fresh air, even if it means entering without breathing apparatus and other safety equipment.
Ensure the full circumstances of the case are properly documented and reported, in order to demonstrate compliance with company requirements.
Prepare a range of safety equipment, in order to be prepared for any type of situation encountered once the rescue team have entered the space.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: Ensure that adequate precautions have been taken to protect the rescue team, thereby preventing additional casualties.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: If enclosed space entry is underway, using an air-line supply and the purpose of the air-lines is not immediately apparent, what should the Responsible Person do? Select the ONE correct option.
options: Instruct the attendant to patrol the deck to ensure nobody interferes with the airlines.
Ban all personnel not involved with the entry operation from the deck area.
Do not use air-line supplied equipment.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: Post notices at appropriate positions.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: If an air-line is being fed from a compressor in the machinery space, who should be informed? Select the ONE best option.
options: The Engineer on Watch, so that the compressor is not shut down until the work is completed.
The Officer on Watch on the bridge, so that this can be noted in the ship's log.
The Master, because they are in overall charge.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: The Engineer on Watch, so that the compressor is not shut down until the work is completed.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: The term “lock out, tag out” refers to which ONE of the following:
options: The securing and labelling of equipment against inadvertent use.
Restrictions on personnel against entering certain areas of the vessel.
The automatic closing of the appropriate valves and other controls by an actuator system in a cargo or ballast pipeline arrangement.
The part of a risk analysis where the Responsible Person goes around and places a blue tag on the valves and controls to be secured.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: The securing and labelling of equipment against inadvertent use.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: When is an enclosed space considered safe and fit for unprotected entry? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: Only when it has been tested and confirmed as “gas free” by a competent person and approved for entry.
When cleaning has finished and the compartment has been rinsed and allowed to dry.
When no unpleasant or irritating smell is detected from the deck hatch.
When somebody else has already gone inside without a gas mask.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: Only when it has been tested and confirmed as “gas free” by a competent person and approved for entry.

CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.question: Breathing apparatus should be inspected and tested periodically, as per the company maintenance schedule.  When else should it be tested for correct operation? Select the ONE correct option.
options: When it has been in use in an enclosed space for more than 45 minutes.
It is not necessary to test it at any other time.
CD0127 — Enclosed Space Entry.answer: Before and after use.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: Details of specific responsibilities assigned to crew members during the launch of the lifeboat are shown where?
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: On the Muster List.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: In the case study into the accident on board the Philippine-flagged bulk carrier “Washington Trader”, the Australian marine accident investigators found the reset lever extremely stiff.  They concluded this was due to:
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: Lack of use.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: Where would you find specific information on the operation and maintenance of the lifeboats and davits on board your ship?
options: The International Guide to Life-saving Appliances on Merchant Vessels.
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: The ship’s SOLAS Training Manual.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: Where would you find specific information on the operation and maintenance of the lifeboats and davits fitted on board your ship?
options: The International Guide to Life-Saving Appliances on Merchant Vessels.
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: The ship’s SOLAS Training Manual.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: In the case study into the accident on board the Philippine-flagged bulk carrier “Washington Trader”, the Australian marine accident investigators found the reset lever extremely stiff.  What reason did they suggest for this?
options: The lever was in a poor location.
Lack of understanding of general evacuation procedures.
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: Lack of use.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: Into which Code were many of the technical items originally found in SOLAS 1974 transferred in 1996?
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: The Life-Saving Appliances Code.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: An “on-load release mechanism” is defined as one:
options: one that can be released at any time from any height when the ship has an adverse list of up to 16 degrees.
…designed to be operated when the boat is hanging in the falls at height of 2-4 metres above the water.
…designed to be operated when the load applied to them is completely removed – that is, when the boat has been lowered and is waterborne.
…designed to be operated when the boat has been lowered and is waterborne, whether or not a load is being applied to it by the action of the ship or the sea.
…that can be released at any time from any height.
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: …designed to be operated when the boat has been lowered and is waterborne, whether or not a load is being applied to it by the action of the ship or the sea.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: Where are details of specific responsibilities assigned to crew members during the launch of the lifeboat indicated?
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: On the Muster List.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: Why is it important to follow a good maintenance routine on the lifeboat release mechanism?
options: Because the Chief Engineer must be able to fill in the information in the Planned Maintenance System.
So that the Remote Release Handle will not jam during a Superintendent’s Inspection.
So that the mechanism will always operate immediately and successfully whenever required.
Because it gives the crew a regular task on weekends.
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: So that the mechanism will always operate immediately and successfully whenever required.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: Prior to recovering a lifeboat back on board, it is essential to:
options: …ensure that the engine is in neutral.
…maintain a minimum of five knots forward speed.
…check that the hook arrangement has properly reset and that the falls are fully engaged.
…establish contact on VHF channel 16 between the ship and the lifeboat.
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: …check that the hook arrangement has properly reset and that the falls are fully engaged.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: “Survival craft, rescue boats and launching appliances shall be visually inspected to ensure that they are ready for use.”^MAt which interval does SOLAS require this procedure to be carried out?
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: Weekly.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: Why have several national authorities released safety circulars in recent years, focusing on maintenance and operation of lifeboat release mechanisms?
options: Because they have been advised to do so by the I.M.O.
Because they feel it necessary to copy releases from the I.M.O.
Because there continue to be serious incidents related to the lifeboat release mechanisms.
Because ship’s Captains have mailed too many “Experience Feedback” forms about lifeboat release mechanisms.
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: Because there continue to be serious incidents related to the lifeboat release mechanisms.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: According to MSC/Circ.1093, which of the following is required to be onboard for use in all operations involving the inspection, maintenance, adjustment and resetting of the lifeboat and associated equipment, such as davits or release gear?
options: A specialized tool-kit supplied by the manufacturer.
Original certificates of competency in lifeboat maintenance for all personnel involved in inspections and maintenance of such equipment.
A full set of maintenance manuals.
A training video or CBT supplied by the manufacturer and approved by the I.M.O.
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: A full set of maintenance manuals.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: Which face of the D-shaped cam pin is in contact with the underside of the locking plate when the mechanism is in the closed position?
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: The curved face.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: According to SOLAS 1974, regulation III/9, where do posters or signs illustrating the procedures for operating survival craft have to be located?
options: In the vicinity of survival craft and their launching controls.
On the inside of the forward hatches of all enclosed lifeboats.
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: In the vicinity of survival craft and their launching controls.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: Which of the following additional items must be done after a weekly or monthly inspection of life-saving appliances?
options: A fire drill must be held.
The lifeboat must be lowered with a complete launching crew embarked.
A report of inspection must be made in the log-book.
The equipment must be treated with preservative.
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: A report of inspection must be made in the log-book.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: Why is it important to train at launching the lifeboat?
options: Because the Captain must be able to prove that he is following company procedures.
So that the crew become thoroughly familiar with the launching mechanism.
In order that launching can be done successfully in the dark.
Because there is an instruction to do so in the planned maintenance system.
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: So that the crew become thoroughly familiar with the launching mechanism.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: When there have been crew changes, special requirements apply for the first abandon ship drill, as detailed in SOLAS 1974, regulation III/19.  Which of the following statements applies?
options: If more than 25% of the crew have not participated in an abandon ship drill on that particular ship within the previous month, a drill must be held within 24 hours of leaving port.
If more than 50% of the crew have not participated in an abandon ship drill on any ship within the previous 3 months, a drill must be held within 3 days of leaving the port.
If any crew members have been changed, a muster should be held before the ship leaves port.

If any new crew members are not in possession of a valid survival craft training certificate from an approved training facility, then a special abandon ship drill must be held for them within 24 hours of boarding the ship.
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: If more than 25% of the crew have not participated in an abandon ship drill on that particular ship within the previous month, a drill must be held within 24 hours of leaving port.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: During resetting of the release mechanism, the hook is manually returned to the upright position. Which of the following will also happen as a result of this action?
options: The locking plate will lift back into place.
The remote release handle will return to the closed position.
The spring-loaded stopper lever will disengage.
The second hook will automatically reset.
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: The locking plate will lift back into place.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: How is the D-shaped cam pin turned back into position under the locking plate during resetting?
options: By manually lifting the cam reset lever.
By the hook pressing against the locking plate.
By pushing the remote release handle back into position.
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: By manually lifting the cam reset lever.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: By SOLAS, how often does a lifeboat (other than those of free-fall design or those on short international voyages and for whom the Administration has approved alternative arrange-ments) have to be launched and manoeuvred in the water by its assigned operating crew?
options: At least once every three months.
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: At least once every three months.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: Weekly and monthly inspections and routine maintenance on lifeboats and associated equipment should be conducted under the direct supervision of which of the following persons?
options: A junior officer assigned to safety duties.
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: A senior officer.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: All inspections, other than weekly and monthly and any servicing and repair, other than routine, should be conducted by which of the following persons?
options: A manufacturer’s representative or a person appropriately trained and certified by the manufacturer for the work to be done.
A senior officer or a fitter suitable qualified and holding a certificate in lifeboat maintenance.
