CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: A manufacturer’s representative or a person appropriately trained and certified by the manufacturer for the work to be done.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: Which component directly holds the hook in the closed position?
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: The locking plate.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: Which of the following is a correct statement?
options: While resetting the release mechanism, it is essential to visually confirm that the spring-loaded stopper lever has returned to the locked position and the locking pin has been replaced
While resetting the release mechanism, it is essential to confirm that all personnel are clear of the boat.
While re-stowing the lifeboat, it is essential to confirm visually that the remote release handle has rotated in the correct direction.
While launching the lifeboat, it is essential that the coxswain is seated at the forward end of the boat.
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: While resetting the release mechanism, it is essential to visually confirm that the spring-loaded stopper lever has returned to the locked position and the locking pin has been replaced

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: “On-load release gear shall be overhauled and subjected to an operational test under a load of 1.1 times the total mass of the lifeboat when loaded with its full complement of persons and equipment”.  At which of the following intervals must this be done?
options: At least once every five years.
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: At least once every five years.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: SOLAS requires that each lifeboat (other than those of free-fall design or those on short international voyages and for whom the Administration has approved alternative arrangements) shall be launched and manoeuvred in the water by its assigned operating crew at what minimum interval?
options: At least once every three months.
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: At least once every three months.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: MSC/Circ.1093 requires which of the following to be onboard for use in all operations involving the inspection, maintenance, adjustment and resetting of the lifeboat and associated equipment, such as davits or release gear?
options: A full set of maintenance manuals.
A specialized tool-kit supplied by the manufacturer.
Original certificates of competency in lifeboat maintenance for any personnel involved in inspections and maintenance of such equipment.
A training manual, video or CBT supplied by the manufacturer and endorsed by the I.M.O.
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: A full set of maintenance manuals.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: Where should the lifeboat be located, in order to perform an operational test on the on-load release mechanism?
options: Fully in the water, such that no load is being applied to the falls and the hydrostatic interlock system has operated successfully.
Partially in the water, such that the mass of the boat is substantially supported by the falls.
Between 3 and 5 metres above the level of the water.
Fully secured in the davits, with additional retaining devices applied.
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: Partially in the water, such that the mass of the boat is substantially supported by the falls.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: All inspections, other than weekly and monthly and any servicing and repair, other than routine, should be conducted by which of the following persons?
options: A senior officer or a fitter suitably qualified and holding a certificate in lifeboat maintenance.
A manufacturer’s representative or a person appropriately trained and certified by the manufacturer for the work to be done.
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: A manufacturer’s representative or a person appropriately trained and certified by the manufacturer for the work to be done.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: Weekly and monthly inspections and routine maintenance on lifeboats and associated equipment should be conducted under the direct supervision of which of the following persons?
options: A junior officer assigned to safety equipment duties.
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: A senior officer.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: On-load release gear shall be overhauled and subjected to an operational test under a load of 1.1 times the total mass of the lifeboat when loaded with its full complement of persons and equipment at which of the following intervals?
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: At least once every 5 years.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: Into which Code were many of the technical items originally found in SOLAS 1974 transferred in 1996?
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: The Life-Saving Appliances Code.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: “Survival craft, rescue boats and launching appliances shall be visually inspected to ensure that they are ready for use.” At which interval does SOLAS require this procedure to be carried out?
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: Weekly.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: Which of the following additional items must be completed following a weekly or monthly inspection of life-saving appliances?
options: The crew must be trained on procedures found in the SOLAS Training Manual.
The lifeboat must be lowered with a complete launching crew embarked.
A report of inspection must be entered in the log-book.
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: A report of inspection must be entered in the log-book.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: The function of the spring-loaded stopper lever is to:
options: Lock the tail end of the hook in the closed position.
Prevent accidental operation of the remote release handle.
Hold the safety pin in place.
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: Prevent accidental operation of the remote release handle.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: When the lifeboat is secured for maintenance or is being transferred to shore, by which parts must the craft be lifted?
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: The auxiliary eye plates.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: Which face of the D-shaped cam pin should be in contact with the locking-plate when it is in the closed postion?
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: The curved face.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: How is the D-shaped cam pin reset prior to recovering the lifeboat?
options: By lowering the cam reset lever.
By resetting the spring-loaded stopper lever.
By lifting the cam reset lever.
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: By lifting the cam reset lever.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: Which of the following is a correct statement?
options: While resetting the release mechanism, it is essential to confirm visually that all personnel are clear of the lifeboat.
While resetting the release mechanism, it is essential to confirm visually that the D-shaped cam pin and spring-loaded stopper lever are in the correct positions.
While re-stowing the lifeboat, it is essential to confirm visually that the remote release handle has rotated in the correct direction.
While launching the lifeboat, it is essential to confirm that the D-shaped cam pin has not released.
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: While resetting the release mechanism, it is essential to confirm visually that the D-shaped cam pin and spring-loaded stopper lever are in the correct positions.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: Which of the following components is spring-loaded?
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: The stopper lever.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: An “on-load release mechanism” is defined as:
options: one that can be released at any time from any height.
one designed to be operated when the boat is hanging in the falls at an approximate height of 2-3 metres above the water.
one designed to be operated when the boat has been lowered and is waterborne, whether or not a load is being applied to it by the action of the ship or the sea.
one designed to be operated when the load applied to them is removed – that is, when the boat has been lowered and is waterborne.
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: one designed to be operated when the boat has been lowered and is waterborne, whether or not a load is being applied to it by the action of the ship or the sea.

CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.question: Which component holds the hook in the closed position?
CD0130 — LRM - IHI GTC.answer: The locking plate.

CD0131 — LRM - MILLS -TITAN-.question: Details of specific responsibilities assigned to crew members during the launch of the lifeboat are shown where?
CD0131 — LRM - MILLS -TITAN-.answer: On the Muster List.

CD0131 — LRM - MILLS -TITAN-.question: In the case study into the accident on board the Philippine-flagged bulk carrier “Washington Trader”, the Australian marine accident investigators found the reset lever extremely stiff.  They concluded this was due to:
CD0131 — LRM - MILLS -TITAN-.answer: Lack of use.

CD0131 — LRM - MILLS -TITAN-.question: Where would you find specific information on the operation and maintenance of the lifeboats and davits on board your ship?
options: The International Guide to Life-saving Appliances on Merchant Vessels.
CD0131 — LRM - MILLS -TITAN-.answer: The ship’s SOLAS Training Manual.

CD0131 — LRM - MILLS -TITAN-.question: Which of the following additional items must be done after a weekly or monthly inspection of life-saving appliances?
options: A fire drill must be held.
The lifeboat must be lowered with a complete launching crew embarked.
A report of inspection must be made in the log-book.
The equipment must be treated with preservative.
CD0131 — LRM - MILLS -TITAN-.answer: A report of inspection must be made in the log-book.

CD0131 — LRM - MILLS -TITAN-.question: “Survival craft, rescue boats and launching appliances shall be visually inspected to ensure that they are ready for use.”^MAt which interval does SOLAS require this procedure to be carried out?
CD0131 — LRM - MILLS -TITAN-.answer: Weekly.

CD0131 — LRM - MILLS -TITAN-.question: “On-load release gear shall be overhauled and subjected to an operational test under a load of 1.1 times the total mass of the lifeboat when loaded with its full complement of persons and equipment”.  At which of the following intervals must this be done?
options: At least once every five years.
CD0131 — LRM - MILLS -TITAN-.answer: At least once every five years.

CD0131 — LRM - MILLS -TITAN-.question: Where should the lifeboat be located when an operational test on the on-load release mechanism is to be performed?
options: Fully in the water, free of all load on the falls and the hydrostatic interlock system having successfully operated.
Partly in the water, such that the mass of the boat is substantially supported by the falls and the hydrostatic interlock system has not operated.
Between 4 and 5 metres above the level of the water.
Fully secured in the davits, with additional retention devices applied.
CD0131 — LRM - MILLS -TITAN-.answer: Partly in the water, such that the mass of the boat is substantially supported by the falls and the hydrostatic interlock system has not operated.

CD0134 — LRM - HARDING FF.question: Which of the following additional items must be completed following a weekly or monthly inspection of life-saving appliances?
options: The crew must be trained on procedures found in the SOLAS Training Manual.
The lifeboat must be lowered with a complete launching crew embarked.
A report of inspection must be entered in the log-book.
CD0134 — LRM - HARDING FF.answer: A report of inspection must be entered in the log-book.

CD0134 — LRM - HARDING FF.question: Which component is most at risk of damage if the hydraulic pressure is not released from the cylinder prior to recovery and refitting of the lifeboat?
CD0134 — LRM - HARDING FF.answer: The piston.

CD0134 — LRM - HARDING FF.question: Prior to operating the remote release handle, which of the following operations must be performed?
options: The bypass valve must be closed.
The safety pin must be replaced.
The safety catch must be removed.
The bypass valve must be opened.
CD0134 — LRM - HARDING FF.answer: The bypass valve must be closed.

CD0134 — LRM - HARDING FF.question: How is the release hook in this mechanism opened?
options: Hydraulic pressure is applied under the lifeboat, taking the strain off the hook and enabling it to be manually released by the crew.
Pneumatic pressure is applied directly to the hook to open it.
The lifeboat Coxswain moves a switch and an electric signal is sent to the automatic release actuator.
Hydraulic pressure turns the hinged catch clear and the weight of the lifeboat opens the hook.
CD0134 — LRM - HARDING FF.answer: Hydraulic pressure turns the hinged catch clear and the weight of the lifeboat opens the hook.

CD0134 — LRM - HARDING FF.question: Which of the following is a correct statement?
options: Prior to launching of the lifeboat, it is essential to release the pressure from the hydraulic cylinder.
Prior to refitting the lifeboat in its stowed position, it is essential to release the pressure from the hydraulic cylinder.
While re-stowing the lifeboat, it is essential to confirm visually that the remote release handle has returned to its highest position.
While launching the lifeboat, it is essential to confirm visually that the piston has extended against the hinged catch.
CD0134 — LRM - HARDING FF.answer: Prior to refitting the lifeboat in its stowed position, it is essential to release the pressure from the hydraulic cylinder.

CD0134 — LRM - HARDING FF.question: The emergency release procedure for this mechanism involves:
options: Using a hydraulic jack to open the release hook.
Smashing the glass panel and rotating the hydrostatic valve.
Smashing the glass panel and pressuring the hydraulic cylinder by turning the end screw.
Removing the glass cover to the remote release handle and disconnecting the securing link.
CD0134 — LRM - HARDING FF.answer: Smashing the glass panel and pressuring the hydraulic cylinder by turning the end screw.

CD0134 — LRM - HARDING FF.question: Which component holds the hook in the “locked” position?
CD0134 — LRM - HARDING FF.answer: The hinged catch.

CD0139 — Awareness of LRRS.question: Why must the handle of a fall preventer device locking pin be painted with a colour different from the hook assembly of a side launched lifeboat? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: To make it apparent to the crew that it must be removed before launching a side-launched lifeboat.
So that it can be fitted quickly in an emergency
So that is easy to find if misplaced or lost.
So that it is not fitted the wrong way round.
CD0139 — Awareness of LRRS.answer: To make it apparent to the crew that it must be removed before launching a side-launched lifeboat.

CD0139 — Awareness of LRRS.question: How does the locking pin fall preventer device prevent accidental release of a side-launched lifeboat? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: It prevents the moveable hook component pivoting
It secures the hook assembly to the fall suspension link
It locks the operating system in place
It stops the hook locking part moving if the hook load is too high.
CD0139 — Awareness of LRRS.answer: It prevents the moveable hook component pivoting

CD0139 — Awareness of LRRS.question: During lowering and raising of a side-launched lifeboat, which of the following precautions must be taken by operating crewmembers to avoid injury by sudden movement of the lifeboat? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: Ensuring seat harnesses are tightly and securely fastened
Standing up and hold on to some firm structure
Wearing a lifejacket and a survival suit
CD0139 — Awareness of LRRS.answer: Ensuring seat harnesses are tightly and securely fastened

CD0139 — Awareness of LRRS.question: When is it best to remove a fall preventer device during launching a side-launched lifeboat? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: When the lifeboat is less than one meter above the water
When the lifeboat is four meters above the water
As soon as the fall block is clear of the davit
CD0139 — Awareness of LRRS.answer: When the lifeboat is less than one meter above the water

CD0139 — Awareness of LRRS.question: How must a manufacturer ensure that a lifeboat release and retrieval system fitted to a lifeboat is safe and reliable? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: A lifeboat release and retrieval system must go through strict testing and evaluation to make sure it meets the standard required under SOLAS
The design needs only to have a mechanical device to prevent accidental release.
The design only needs to be made of non-rusting materials
The manufacturer needs only to check that it works properly before leaving the factory
CD0139 — Awareness of LRRS.answer: A lifeboat release and retrieval system must go through strict testing and evaluation to make sure it meets the standard required under SOLAS

CD0139 — Awareness of LRRS.question: What is the correct order for the actions the coxswain must carry out when releasing a side-launched lifeboat off-load? Select the ONE correct answer?
options: Check the hydrostatic interlock has lifted, remove the safety pin and pull back the release handle.
Remove the safety pin, check the hydrostatic interlock has lifted, pull back the release handle.
Pull back the release handle, check the hydrostatic interlock has lifted and remove the safety pin.
Check the hydrostatic interlock has lifted, pull back the release handle and remove the safety pin.
CD0139 — Awareness of LRRS.answer: Check the hydrostatic interlock has lifted, remove the safety pin and pull back the release handle.

CD0139 — Awareness of LRRS.question: In which of the following situations should a side-launched lifeboat be released on-load? Select the ONE correct answer?
options: When abandoning ship in rough seas.
During a lifeboat drill when the lifeboat is being lowered into the water
After the lifeboat release and retrieval system has been repaired by the ship’s staff
During a drill when permission is obtained from the ship’s superintendent
CD0139 — Awareness of LRRS.answer: When abandoning ship in rough seas.

CD0139 — Awareness of LRRS.question: If the hook assembly is badly damaged, under what circumstances can a side-launched lifeboat be launched and retrieved? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: The lifeboat cannot be launched and retrieved until it has been properly repaired and tested by a suitably qualified technician authorized by the manufacturer
It can be launched and retrieved only after a risk assessment has been completed following temporary repairs by the chief engineer.
It can be launched and retrieved during a drill with a fall preventer device
It can be launched and retrieved but the maximum number of persons it is certified to carry must be reduced by half
CD0139 — Awareness of LRRS.answer: The lifeboat cannot be launched and retrieved until it has been properly repaired and tested by a suitably qualified technician authorized by the manufacturer

CD0139 — Awareness of LRRS.question: During retrieval, why is it necessary to stop raising the lifeboat when just clear of the water? Select the ONE best answer.
options: To recheck that the lifeboat release and retrieval system is properly reset and all interlocks are in place
To give time for the operating crew to store equipment.
To check the painter is properly secure.
CD0139 — Awareness of LRRS.answer: To recheck that the lifeboat release and retrieval system is properly reset and all interlocks are in place

CD0139 — Awareness of LRRS.question: Which of the following could be an indicator of poor maintenance on a lifeboat release and retrieval system? Select the ONE best answer.
options: The release handle is very stiff to operate
Spanner found lying in the lifeboat bilges
Grease found on greasing points and linkages
Release handle cannot able to be opened due safety pin in place
CD0139 — Awareness of LRRS.answer: The release handle is very stiff to operate

CD0139 — Awareness of LRRS.question: Where can detailed maintenance requirements for lifeboat release and retrieval systems be found? Select the ONE best answer.
options: In the shipboard management system manual
On the maintenance instructions that are posted in the lifeboat
In the SOLAS life Saving appliances training manual

CD0139 — Awareness of LRRS.question: When lowering a side-launched lifeboat, when is the hook load approximately zero? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: When the lifeboat is stationary and floating in the water
As soon as it clears the lifeboat davits
As soon as the lifeboat keel touches the water
CD0139 — Awareness of LRRS.answer: When the lifeboat is stationary and floating in the water

CD0139 — Awareness of LRRS.question: How often are the hooks of a lifeboat release and retrieval system tested to ensure they release when the lifeboat is loaded to 1.1 times its fully loaded weight? Select the ONE correct answer.
What is the hook load when a side-launched lifeboat is launched off-load? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: Half the weight of the lifeboat
Twice the weight of the lifeboat

CD0139 — Awareness of LRRS.question: In which of the following situations would it be necessary to manually raise and hold the hydrostatic safety interlock of a lifeboat release and retrieval system? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: When it is necessary to launch a side-launched lifeboat off-load and the hydrostatic safety interlock fails to unlock the release handle.
To launch a side launched lifeboat off-load in calm seas
To reconnect the lifeboat to the hooks prior to retrieval
When the operating system safety pin interlock is stuck and cannot be removed
CD0139 — Awareness of LRRS.answer: When it is necessary to launch a side-launched lifeboat off-load and the hydrostatic safety interlock fails to unlock the release handle.

CD0139 — Awareness of LRRS.question: What is the name of the part that connects the release handle to the hook locking parts in a lifeboat release and retrieval system? Select the ONE correct answer.
In a lifeboat release and retrieval system, what is the part that prevents the moveable hook component pivoting until it is moved by the operating system? Select the ONE correct answer.
What is the purpose of an interlock in the operating system of a lifeboat release and retrieval system? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: To prevent accidental pulling of the release handle
To lock the moveable hook component in place
To stop the hook locking part from moving
To lock the lifeboat access to prevent unauthorized use of the operating system
CD0139 — Awareness of LRRS.answer: To prevent accidental pulling of the release handle

CD0139 — Awareness of LRRS.question: Who carries out the annual thorough inspection on a lifeboat release and retrieval system? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: The manufacturer's representative or contractor authorized by them
The Chief Officer as long as they have read the manufacturer’s maintenance manual
Any contractor who has experience working on lifeboats and davit systems
CD0139 — Awareness of LRRS.answer: The manufacturer's representative or contractor authorized by them

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: For the purposes of communications relating to an incident, who is the nominated representative of the Owner of the vessel?
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: The Master

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Para fins de comunicações relacionadas a algum incidente, quem é designado o representante do Proprietário da embarcação?
options: O Agente de Segurança do Navio
O Oficial de Segurança do Navio
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: O comandante

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Which of the following will usually be missing in a near-miss investigation?
options: The presence of adequate alarm systems
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: Evidence of loss

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Qual das alternativas a seguir, em geral, não estará presente em uma investigação sobre um quase acidente?
options: A presença de sistemas de alarme adequados
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: Evidência de perda

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: There has been an incident on board the vessel, with some casualties and pollution.  A local newspaper reporter approaches the seaman on duty at the gangway and asks him to explain what happened.  He offers the man $50 for his help.  How should the seaman be trained to react to such an approach?
options: He should not enter into any discussion relating to the incident.  He should refuse admission to the reporter
He should accept the money and politely answer the reporter’s questions
He should call the Bosun on his radio and ask him to come and talk with the reporter
He should do his best to answer the reporter’s questions, but ensure that the man’s name and who he works for is properly recorded in the gangway log
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: He should not enter into any discussion relating to the incident.  He should refuse admission to the reporter

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Ocorreu um incidente a bordo da embarcação, com algumas vítimas e poluição.  Um repórter de um jornal local aborda o marinheiro em serviço no portaló e pede a ele para explicar o que aconteceu.  Ele oferece ao homem US$ 50,00 pela ajuda.  Como o marinheiro deveria ser treinado para reagir a essa abordagem?
options: Ele não deveria participar de nenhuma discussão relacionada ao incidente.  Ele deveria negar acesso ao repórter
Ele deveria aceitar o dinheiro e responder educadamente às perguntas do repórter
Ele deveria ligar para o contramestre pelo rádio e solicitar que viesse falar com o repórter
Ele deveria dar o melhor de si para responder às perguntas do repórter, mas assegurar que seu nome e o de seu empregador fossem devidamente registrados no diário do portaló
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: Ele não deveria participar de nenhuma discussão relacionada ao incidente.  Ele deveria negar acesso ao repórter

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Which of the following is the definition of “evidence”, as described in this training program?
options: The opinions of witnesses interviewed during an investigation
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: Something that demonstrates proof

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Qual das alternativas a seguir é a definição de "evidência" conforme descrito no programa de treinamento?
options: As opiniões das testemunhas entrevistadas durante uma investigação
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: Algo que serve como prova

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: What kind of culture do we say exists where people look no further than “human error”?
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: A blame culture

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Como definimos o tipo de cultura existente dos lugares onde as pessoas não enxergam além do "erro humano"?
options: Uma cultura de trabalho em equipe
Uma cultura de gerenciamento da segurança
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: Uma cultura de culpa

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: If accidents are not investigated and the causes addressed, which of the following might reasonably be expected to happen in the future?
options: Further similar accidents, incidents and near-misses will occur
Personal injuries will decrease, but material damage will continue
Those responsible will be more easily identified
The crew will become practiced at hiding accidents and incidents from the company
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: Further similar accidents, incidents and near-misses will occur

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Se os acidentes não forem investigados e as causas não forem tratadas, qual das seguintes situações terá chances razoáveis de acontecer no futuro?
options: Mais acidentes, incidentes e quase acidentes similares ocorrerão
As lesões pessoais diminuirão, mas o dano material continuará existindo
Os responsáveis serão identificados mais facilmente
A tripulação se tornará especialista em ocultar da empresa acidentes e incidentes
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: Mais acidentes, incidentes e quase acidentes similares ocorrerão

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: In terms of investigation, which of the following may be considered as the results or effects of an accident?
options: The loss experienced at the end of a sequence of events
The elements in a sequence of events prior to the point of contact
Serious material damage, but not any physical injury
Visible costs in material replacement and repair only
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: The loss experienced at the end of a sequence of events

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Em termos de investigação, qual das seguintes opções pode ser considerada como os resultados ou os efeitos de um acidente?
options: A perda experimentada ao final de uma sequência de eventos
Os elementos em uma sequência de eventos antes do ponto de contato
Sério prejuízo material, mas sem nenhum dano físico
Custos visíveis em substituição de material e reparo apenas
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: A perda experimentada ao final de uma sequência de eventos

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Which of the following is the definition of an “impartial” witness, within the context of this program?
options: One who has no personal interest and nothing to gain, or lose
One with a personal interest in the outcome of the inquiry
One with whom there is a language-based communication problem
One who has a problem with authority and feels threatened by the interview
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: One who has no personal interest and nothing to gain, or lose

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Qual das seguintes opções é uma definição de testemunha "imparcial" no contexto deste programa?
options: Uma testemunha imparcial não tem interesse pessoal e nada a ganhar nem a perder.
Alguém com um interesse pessoal no resultado da investigação
Alguém com quem há um problema de comunicação relacionado ao idioma
Alguém que tenha problemas com autoridades e se sinta ameaçado pela entrevista
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: Uma testemunha imparcial não tem interesse pessoal e nada a ganhar nem a perder.

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Which safety initiative, launched by the Oil Companies International Marine Forum in 1993, takes the form of a risk-assessment tool for charterers, ship operators, terminal operators and government bodies and includes verifying if an accident and incident investigation policy exists within a company?
options: The International Risk Assessment Guide for Ship and Terminal Operators
The Ship Operator Voluntary Audit Scheme
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: The SIRE Programme

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Que iniciativa de segurança lançada pelo Fórum Marítimo Internacional das Companhias Petrolíferas em 1993 tem a forma de uma ferramenta de avaliação de risco para afretadores, operadores de navios, operadores de terminais e órgãos do governo e inclui a verificação da existência de uma política de investigação de acidentes e incidentes em uma empresa?
options: O Guia Internacional para Avaliação de Riscos para Navios e Operadores de Terminais
O Sistema Voluntário de Auditoria do Operador de Navios
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: O programa SIRE

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: An investigator arrives on board to conduct an inquiry into an incident involving some damaged containers, several of which have collapsed and fallen forward onto the back of the forecastle deck.  Which of the following will he initially seek to identify?
options: Where the biggest impact has taken place
How the greatest damage was caused
The sequence of events leading to the incident
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: The transfer of energy

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Um investigador embarca para conduzir um inquérito sobre um acidente envolvendo alguns contêineres danificados, vários dos quais despencaram e caíram sobre a parte de trás do castelo de proa.  Qual das opções a seguir ele buscará identificar inicialmente?
options: Como foi causado o maior dano
A sequência de eventos que levou ao incidente
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: A transferência de energia

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: In respect of incident investigation, complacency, incompetence, negligence, recklessness and lack of communication are all examples of what?
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: Fallability

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: A respeito de investigações de incidentes, complacência, incompetência, negligência, imprudência e falta de comunicação são exemplos de quê?
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: Falibilidade

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Within the context of this training module, which of the following is the definition of a “near-miss”?
options: An unintended or unwanted event, or uncontrolled development in the course of an operation, that almost resulted in unintended harm or damage, or potential for legal action, or is not consistent with acceptable standards
An intended or desired event, or controlled sequence of events, in the course of an operation, that  was not accounted for in the applicable risk assessment
An occurrence in which personnel are found  to have been operating in compliance with the  International Safety Management Code
An operation, or phase in an operation, in which personnel, the ship, its equipment or cargo, or the environment,  almost, but not quite, comply with all applicable regulations and procedures
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: An unintended or unwanted event, or uncontrolled development in the course of an operation, that almost resulted in unintended harm or damage, or potential for legal action, or is not consistent with acceptable standards

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: No contexto deste módulo de treinamento, qual das seguintes alternativas é a definição de um "quase acidente"?
options: Um evento indesejado ou não intencional ou um desenvolvimento não controlado durante uma operação que quase resulta em dano ou prejuízo não intencional, gera potencial de ação judicial ou não é consistente com os padrões aceitáveis.
Um evento intencional ou desejado (ou uma sequência de eventos controlados) durante uma operação que não foi considerado na avaliação de risco aplicável.
Uma situação em que se descobre que funcionários estiveram operando em conformidade com o Código Internacional de Gerenciamento de Segurança

Uma operação ou uma etapa de uma operação em que os funcionários, o navio, seu equipamento, sua carga ou o ambiente esteja em conformidade com quase todas as regulamentações e os procedimentos aplicáveis
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: Um evento indesejado ou não intencional ou um desenvolvimento não controlado durante uma operação que quase resulta em dano ou prejuízo não intencional, gera potencial de ação judicial ou não é consistente com os padrões aceitáveis.

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Within the context of this training module, which of the following is the definition of an “incident”?
options: An uncontrolled development in the course of an operation which has resulted in unintended harm or damage, or the potential for legal action, or is not consistent with acceptable standards
An unforeseen event that has resulted in unintended harm or damage
A planned event that has resulted in deliberate damage
A situation where personnel have been injured as a result of failure to comply with the operating requirements of the company’s Safety Management System
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: An uncontrolled development in the course of an operation which has resulted in unintended harm or damage, or the potential for legal action, or is not consistent with acceptable standards

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: No contexto deste módulo de treinamento, qual das seguintes alternativas é a definição de um "incidente"?
options: Um desenvolvimento não controlado durante uma operação que resulta em dano ou prejuízo não intencional, gera potencial de ação judicial ou não é consistente com os padrões aceitáveis.
Um evento imprevisto que resulta em dano ou prejuízo não intencional
Um evento planejado que resulta em dano deliberado
Uma situação em que funcionários tenham sido feridos como resultado de não conformidade com os requisitos operacionais do Sistema de Gerenciamento de Segurança
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: Um desenvolvimento não controlado durante uma operação que resulta em dano ou prejuízo não intencional, gera potencial de ação judicial ou não é consistente com os padrões aceitáveis.

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Acts and practises identified in an incident are compared against a “standard”.  What is that standard?
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: The applicable operating procedure

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Atos e práticas identificados em um incidente são comparados com um "padrão".  Qual é esse padrão?
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: O procedimento de operação aplicável

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: What is it that starts the process of cause and effect and ultimately results in the “loss” evidenced in the incident?
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: Lack of control

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: O que inicia o processo de causa e efeito e acaba resultando na "perda" evidenciada no incidente?
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: Falta de controle

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Which of the following best explains the purpose of an investigation into an accident, incident or near miss on board ship?
options: The establishment of facts and the determination of corrective action, aimed at the prevention of a recurrence of the incident.  It is not to determine the allocation of blame
Primarily the allocation of blame, but also the identification of relevant contributory factors.  It may suggest corrective action
The drawing up of corrective action, including disciplinary procedures where appropriate.  Applicable contributory factors may not necessarily be identified
The completion of the necessary forms, so that an incident is on record and an auditor can see that a system for selectively documenting certain incidents exists
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: The establishment of facts and the determination of corrective action, aimed at the prevention of a recurrence of the incident.  It is not to determine the allocation of blame

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Qual das seguintes opções explica melhor o propósito de uma investigação sobre um acidente, um incidente ou um quase acidente em um navio?
options: O estabelecimento de fatos e a determinação de medida corretiva, visando prevenir a recorrência do incidente.  O objetivo não é a atribuição de culpa
Primeiramente, a atribuição de culpa, mas também a identificação de fatores associados também é relevante.  Isso pode sugerir uma medida corretiva
A elaboração da medida corretiva, incluindo procedimentos disciplinares quando apropriado.  Fatores associados aplicáveis podem não ser identificados
O preenchimento dos formulários necessários para que um incidente seja registrado e um auditor possa ver que há um sistema para a documentação seletiva de certos incidentes
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: O estabelecimento de fatos e a determinação de medida corretiva, visando prevenir a recorrência do incidente.  O objetivo não é a atribuição de culpa

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: What broad rule is often referred to by safety investigators when explaining the selective investigation of reported incidents?
options: Bernhard’s principle of Selective Accident Investigation
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: The 80 / 20 rule

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: A que regra geral os investigadores de segurança normalmente se referem quando estão explicando a investigação seletiva de incidentes notificados?
options: O princípio da Investigação Seletiva de Acidentes de Bernhard
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: A regra dos 80/20

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Which maritime Code requires shipping companies to provide for safe practices in ship operation and a safe working environment, establish safeguards against all identified risks and to continuously improve safety management skills of personnel ashore and aboard ships, including preparing for emergencies related both to safety and environmental protection?
options: The International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS)
The International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code
The International Convention for the Prevention of Pollution from Ships (MARPOL)
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: The International Safety Management (ISM) Code

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Que Código marítimo requer que as companhias de navegação ofereçam práticas seguras para operação das embarcações e um ambiente de trabalho seguro, estabeleçam meios de segurança contra todos os riscos identificados e melhorem continuamente as habilidades em gerenciamento de segurança de funcionários em terra e a bordo, incluindo preparação para emergências relacionadas tanto à segurança quanto à proteção ambiental?
options: O International Safety Management (ISM) Code (Código (ISM) Internacional de Gerenciamento de Segurança).
A International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS) (Convenção Internacional para a Salvaguarda da Vida Humana no Mar).
O International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code (Código Internacional para a Proteção dos Navios e das Instalações Portuárias) (ISPS)
A International Convention for Prevention of Pollution from Ships (MARPOL) (Convenção Internacional para a Prevenção da Poluição por Navios)
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: O International Safety Management (ISM) Code (Código (ISM) Internacional de Gerenciamento de Segurança).

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: If an officer is instructed to investigate an incident which involved a broken wire on a mooring winch and he is supporting his inquiry with photographs, how should he try to photograph the wire?
options: In place, still on the winch drum
In the forecastle store, having been removed from the winch drum.
Ashore, having been removed from the vessel
He should not take photographs of the broken wire
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: In place, still on the winch drum

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Se um oficial for instruído a investigar um incidente envolvendo um fio partido em um guincho de atracação e quiser respaldar sua investigação com fotos, como ele deverá fotografar o fio?
options: No lugar, ainda no tambor do guincho
No paiol do castelo de proa, tendo sido removido do tambor do guincho.
Em terra, tendo sido removido da embarcação
Ele não deve fotografar o fio partido
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: No lugar, ainda no tambor do guincho

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: When we refer to a “blame culture”, what kind of culture do we consider typically exists?
options: One where people look no further than “human error”
One where investigators seek to blame as many people as possible
One which seeks to avoid apportioning any degree of blame
One in which the level of responsibility of each person involved in an incident is allocated as a percentage
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: One where people look no further than “human error”

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Quando nos referimos a uma "cultura de culpa", que tipo de cultura consideramos que exista normalmente?
options: Uma em que as pessoas não procuram por mais do que o "erro humano"
Uma em que os investigadores tentam culpar o máximo de pessoas que puderem
Uma que busca evitar a atribuição de qualquer grau de culpa
Uma em que o grau de responsabilidade de cada pessoa envolvida em um acidente seja atribuído como uma porcentagem
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: Uma em que as pessoas não procuram por mais do que o "erro humano"

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: If accidents are investigated and the information obtained is constructively fed back into the system, which of the following might reasonably be anticipated?
options: A reduction, or even elimination of such accidents in the future
An increased likelihood of the repetition of such accidents in the future
A reduction in personal injuries, matched by a corresponding increase in incidents involving material damage
A more efficient system will be developed for the purposes of allocating blame
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: A reduction, or even elimination of such accidents in the future

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Se os acidentes forem investigados e as informações obtidas forem colocadas no sistema construtivamente, quais das seguintes opções poderão ser razoavelmente previstas?
options: Uma redução ou mesmo uma eliminação de tais acidentes no futuro
Uma probabilidade maior da repetição de tais acidentes no futuro
Uma redução em danos pessoais equiparada a um aumento correspondente em incidentes envolvendo prejuízo material
Um sistema mais eficiente será desenvolvido com o propósito de atribuir culpa
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: Uma redução ou mesmo uma eliminação de tais acidentes no futuro

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Which of the following is the definition of “circumstantial evidence”, as understood by this module?
options: Something that may reasonably be said to be relevant to an incident
Something found in physical objects, which cannot often be disputed
Information obtained through a third party
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: Something that may reasonably be said to be relevant to an incident

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Qual das alternativas a seguir é a definição de "evidência circunstancial" conforme entendido neste módulo?
options: Algo que possa, de maneira sensata, ser considerado relevante para um incidente
Algo encontrado em objetos físicos, que frequentemente não pode ser contestado
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: Algo que possa, de maneira sensata, ser considerado relevante para um incidente

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Following an accident onboard, there is an enquiry from a lawyer on the ship’s satellite telephone, whilst at anchor awaiting port entry.  Who should the Duty Officer direct the call to?
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: The Master

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Depois de um acidente a bordo, há um advogado fazendo perguntas pelo telefone por satélite do navio, enquanto ancorado, aguardando a entrada no porto.  A quem o oficial de serviço deve direcionar a chamada?
options: O Agente de Segurança do Navio
O Oficial de Segurança do Navio
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: O comandante

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Which of the following best describes the form that the narrative section of an Incident Investigation Report should follow?
options: A simple, orderly description of the events leading up to the accident, incident or near miss, the circumstances of the accident, incident or near miss itself, the consequences and the post-incident actions, written in a neutral way, without opinion or judgment.

A random description of the events preceding an incident, or near miss and the corrective actions necessary to prevent a recurrence, written in a neutral way, but including the investigator’s summary assessment.

A complex and detailed account of the accident, incident or near miss only, reflecting, so far as possible, the investigator’s understanding of the circumstances and including recommendations for the attention of management.
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: A simple, orderly description of the events leading up to the accident, incident or near miss, the circumstances of the accident, incident or near miss itself, the consequences and the post-incident actions, written in a neutral way, without opinion or judgment.

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Qual das seguintes opções descreve melhor a forma como deve ser a seção narrativa de um Relatório de Investigação de Incidente?
options: Uma descrição simples e ordenada dos eventos que levaram ao acidente, ao incidente ou ao quase acidente, das circunstâncias do acidente, do incidente ou do quase acidente em si, das consequências e das medidas tomadas após o incidente. Deve ser escrita de forma neutra, sem opiniões e julgamentos.

Uma descrição aleatória dos eventos que precederam um incidente ou um quase acidente e as medidas corretivas necessárias para prevenir uma recorrência, escrita de maneira neutra, mas incluindo a avaliação resumida do investigador.

Uma descrição completa e detalhada do acidente, do incidente ou do quase acidente, refletindo, o máximo possível, a compreensão que o investigador tem das circunstâncias e incluindo as recomendações para consideração da gerência.
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: Uma descrição simples e ordenada dos eventos que levaram ao acidente, ao incidente ou ao quase acidente, das circunstâncias do acidente, do incidente ou do quase acidente em si, das consequências e das medidas tomadas após o incidente. Deve ser escrita de forma neutra, sem opiniões e julgamentos.

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: When presenting findings and recommendations in a report for onboard use, which of the following will help to increase understanding and interest?
options: Avoid jargon and keep it simple
Print the report in large type
Print plenty of copies of the report and post them all over the ship
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: Avoid jargon and keep it simple

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Ao apresentar as conclusões e as recomendações em um relatório para uso a bordo, qual das alternativas a seguir ajudará a aumentar a compreensão e o interesse?
options: Evitar usar o nome do navio
Imprimir o relatório com uma fonte grande
Imprimir muitas cópias do relatório e publicá-las por todo o navio
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: Evitar jargões e simplificar

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: As indicated in this training program, what is the most valuable outcome of an incident investigation?
options: The establishment of control to the extent that it prevents the repeat of a similar incident in the future
A good report that will impress an auditor
That the Company can demonstrate that it investigates incidents in compliance with the ISM Code and other legislation
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: The establishment of control to the extent that it prevents the repeat of a similar incident in the future

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Conforme indicado neste programa de treinamento, qual é o resultado mais importante das investigações de incidentes?
options: O estabelecimento de controle que permite evitar a repetição de um incidente similar no futuro
Um bom relatório capaz de impressionar um auditor
Que a empresa possa demonstrar que investiga incidentes em conformidade com o Código ISM e as demais legislações
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: O estabelecimento de controle que permite evitar a repetição de um incidente similar no futuro

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: If a chain is used to illustrate the sequence of events leading up to and surrounding an accident, at what point is the accident itself considered to take place?
options: At the first link, corresponding to the basic cause
At the final link, corresponding to the recovery or further deterioration phase in the sequence
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: At the weakest link

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Caso seja usada uma corrente para ilustrar a sequência de eventos que levam a um acidente e o envolvem, em que momento se considerará que o acidente em si ocorreu?
options: No primeiro elo, correspondente à causa básica
No último elo, correspondente à recuperação ou à fase de deterioração adicional na sequência
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: No elo mais fraco

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: When an accident is investigated, which of the following will be considered as its results or effects?
options: The loss experienced at the end of a sequence of events
The phases in an accident after the build-up period
Serious physical injury, but not damage to property
Breakage or damage to property or the environment, but not involving physical injury
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: The loss experienced at the end of a sequence of events

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Quando um acidente é investigado, qual das seguintes alternativas é considerada seu resultado ou efeito?
options: A perda experimentada ao final de uma sequência de eventos
As fases em um acidente após o período de desenvolvimento
Lesão física grave, mas sem dano à propriedade
Quebra ou dano à propriedade ou ao ambiente, mas sem envolver lesão física
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: A perda experimentada ao final de uma sequência de eventos

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Within the context of this training module, which of the following is the definition of an “accident”?
options: An unforeseen event that has resulted in unintended harm or damage
A planned event that has resulted in deliberate damage
An uncontrolled development in the course of an operation which has resulted in unintended harm or damage, or the potential for legal action, or is not consistent with acceptable standards
A situation where personnel have been injured as a result of not operating in compliance with the Safety Management System
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: An unforeseen event that has resulted in unintended harm or damage

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: No contexto deste módulo de treinamento, qual das seguintes alternativas é a definição de um "acidente"?
options: Um evento imprevisto que resulta em dano ou prejuízo não intencional
Um evento planejado que resulta em dano deliberado
Um desenvolvimento não controlado durante uma operação que resulta em dano ou prejuízo não intencional, gera potencial de ação judicial ou não é consistente com os padrões aceitáveis.
Uma situação em que a tripulação sofre lesão decorrente de uma operação que desrespeita o Sistema de Gerenciamento de Segurança
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: Um evento imprevisto que resulta em dano ou prejuízo não intencional

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Which guidelines, produced by the Oil Companies International Marine Forum in 1997, are intended to promote, among tanker operators, an increased understanding and awareness of personnel safety through the efficient and accurate reporting and recording of accidents?
options: The International Marine Personal Safety Guide
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: The Marine Injury Reporting Guidelines

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Quais diretrizes produzidas pelo Fórum Marítimo Internacional das Companhias Petrolíferas em 1997 têm por objetivo promover, entre os operadores de navios-petroleiros, maior entendimento e consciência de segurança pessoal por meio de registros e notificações eficientes e precisos de acidentes?
options: As Diretrizes de Notificação de Danos Marinhos
O Guia Internacional de Segurança Pessoal no Setor Marítimo
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: As Diretrizes de Notificação de Danos Marinhos

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Which incident is credited with first bringing about a major focus on what is called the “human element” in maritime disasters?
options: The sinking of the “Herald of Free Enterprise”
The collision between the “Norwegian Dream” and the “Ever Decent”
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: The sinking of the “Herald of Free Enterprise”

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Qual incidente tem o crédito por colocar um foco importante no que se chama "elemento humano" em desastres marítimos?
options: O naufrágio do “Herald of Free Enterprise”
A colisão entre o “Norwegian Dream” e o “Ever Decent”
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: O naufrágio do “Herald of Free Enterprise”

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Which piece of international legislation directly resulted from the sinking of the “Herald of Free Enterprise”?
options: The International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS)
The International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code
The International Convention for the Prevention of Pollution from Ships (MARPOL)
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: The International Safety Management (ISM) Code

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Qual parte da legislação internacional é resultado direto do naufrágio do "Herald of Free Enterprise"?
options: O International Safety Management (ISM) Code (Código (ISM) Internacional de Gerenciamento de Segurança).
A International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS) (Convenção Internacional para a Salvaguarda da Vida Humana no Mar).
O International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code (Código Internacional para a Proteção dos Navios e das Instalações Portuárias) (ISPS)
A International Convention for Prevention of Pollution from Ships (MARPOL) (Convenção Internacional para a Prevenção da Poluição por Navios)
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: O International Safety Management (ISM) Code (Código (ISM) Internacional de Gerenciamento de Segurança).

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: What connection is there between the sinking of the s.s. “Titanic” in 1912 and a method commonly used to illustrate the relationship between reported and unreported accidents and incidents?
options: The “Titanic” was sunk when she struck an iceberg and an iceberg is commonly used to illustrate how the large numbers of unreported incidents go “unseen”.
The White Star Line, owners of the “Titanic” conducted and published the findings of the first major study into accidents and incidents involving loss of life at sea.
The decks of the “Titanic” and the numbers of available life-saving appliances respectively placed on them are often illustrated in pyramid form.
The ratio between the numbers of survivors and those lost when the “Titanic” sank are frequently used as a benchmark in studies into modern-day marine casualties.
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: The “Titanic” was sunk when she struck an iceberg and an iceberg is commonly used to illustrate how the large numbers of unreported incidents go “unseen”.

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Qual é a ligação entre o naufrágio do S.S. Titanic em 1912 e o método normalmente utilizado para ilustrar a relação que os acidentes e os incidentes notificados e os não notificados têm em comum?
options: O "Titanic" afundou quando bateu contra um iceberg, e os icebergs normalmente são usados para ilustrar como um vasto número de incidentes não notificados passa "despercebido".
A White Star Line, proprietária do "Titanic", conduziu e publicou as conclusões do primeiro grande estudo sobre acidentes e incidentes envolvendo perda de vida no mar.
Os conveses do "Titanic" e o número de equipamentos salva-vidas respectivamente colocados neles são com frequência ilustrados em forma de pirâmide.
A relação entre o número de sobreviventes e o de mortos quando o "Titanic" afundou é frequentemente usada como uma referência nos estudos sobre acidentes na marinha moderna.
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: O "Titanic" afundou quando bateu contra um iceberg, e os icebergs normalmente são usados para ilustrar como um vasto número de incidentes não notificados passa "despercebido".

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: What principal factor may indicate that safety studies such as those discussed in this chapter are not necessarily representative of true life?
options: They are based only on those accidents and incidents which are reported.
The companies and organizations selected for inclusion in such studies are chosen so that a particular set of trends can be illustrated.

The exact details of the accidents and incidents used to compile the statistics used in such studies are controlled by the data protection act and cannot therefore be verified as accurate and complete.
Most studies are conducted in the US and do not reflect practices in the rest of the world.
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: They are based only on those accidents and incidents which are reported.

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Qual fator principal pode indicar que os estudos sobre segurança, como os discutidos neste capítulo, não representam necessariamente a vida real?
options: Eles são baseados apenas nos acidentes e nos incidentes notificados.
As empresas e as organizações selecionadas para inclusão nesses estudos são escolhidas de modo que um conjunto específico de tendências possa ser ilustrado.

Os detalhes exatos dos acidentes e dos incidentes utilizados para compilar as estatísticas usadas nesses estudos são controlados pela lei de proteção de dados; por isso, não é possível verificar se são precisos e completos.
A maioria dos estudos é conduzida nos Estados Unidos e não reflete as práticas adotadas no resto do mundo.
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: Eles são baseados apenas nos acidentes e nos incidentes notificados.

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: The study conducted by the North of England P&I Club used the example of a man and a ladder alongside the accident pyramid to further illustrate their conclusions.  What relationship did this further suggest?
options: That the severity of accidents depends on the degree of hazard.
That the severity of accidents and incidents bears no relation to the prevailing exposure to risk.
That the statistics are better illustrated by a rectangular shape than a pyramid.
That such studies are only of value when physical injury is involved.
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: That the severity of accidents depends on the degree of hazard.

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: O estudo conduzido pela North of England P&I Club usou o exemplo de um homem e de uma escada ao lado da pirâmide de acidentes para ilustrar melhor suas conclusões.  Que relação isso sugere?
options: Que a gravidade dos acidentes depende do grau de perigo.
Que a gravidade dos acidentes e dos incidentes não tem relação com a predominante exposição ao risco.
Que as estatísticas são mais bem ilustradas como um retângulo do que como uma pirâmide.
Que tais estudos sejam úteis apenas quando houver lesões físicas.
CD0149 — Incident Investigation.answer: Que a gravidade dos acidentes depende do grau de perigo.

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Safety investigators often investigate and analyse only a selective “percentage” of incidents and accidents.  What percentage does this training module suggest is generally used?

CD0149 — Incident Investigation.question: Um investigador é confrontado pelos resultados de um acidente no qual uma pilha de cabos de aço caiu sobre algumas caixas de mercadorias em um porão de carga e as esmagou.  Qual das opções a seguir ele buscará identificar inicialmente?

One on each end and one visible from directly above.
CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.answer: One on each end and one on each side.

CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.question: What does this label indicate?
options: The substance to which it refers is a marine pollutant.
The substance within the package is toxic.
The contents of the package are organic.
CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.answer: The substance to which it refers is a marine pollutant.

CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.question: How must salvage packaging be specially marked?
options: With the warning CAUTION – SALVED GOODS
With the caution DANGER – SALVAGED GOODS

CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.question: Can the hazard posed by a substance arise from a dangerous reaction of the substance or article with other substances in the surrounding environment?
Which of these definitions is that of a “Marine Pollutant” under the IMDG Code?
options: A substance which is subject to the provisions of Annex III of MARPOL 73/78, as amended.
A substance which is subject to the provisions of Chapter V of SOLAS 1974, as amended.
Any substance which is hazardous to the marine environment.

A substance which, because of its tendency to degrade in seafood, or because of its hazard potential to the aquatic environment is subject to the provisions of Annex I of MARPOL 73/78, as amended, and carried by sea accordingly.
CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.answer: A substance which is subject to the provisions of Annex III of MARPOL 73/78, as amended.

CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.question: How many classes of Dangerous Goods are there in the IMDG Code?
One particular group of substances may reasonably be considered the most dangerous transported by ship. Which is it?
How would you expect to find a package that previously contained a consignment of UN Number 2067 marked? It is in an uncleaned condition and there are still heavy residual vapours inside the package.
options: Empty packages are not required to be marked.

CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.question: To which explosives compatibility Class are “Articles containing a secondary detonating explosive substance, without means of initiation, with a propelling charge (other than one containing a flammable liquid or gel or hypergolic liquids)” assigned?
A marking label coloured green will refer to dangerous goods of which class?
options: Those listed with the UN Environmental Committee approval.

CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.question: Where will a dangerous substance, material or article not mentioned specifically by name in the Dangerous Goods List, appear in the IMDG Code?
options: In the List of Generic and N.O.S. Proper Shipping Names.
It will not appear anywhere in the Code.
In the List of Class 9 Substances, Materials and Articles.
CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.answer: In the List of Generic and N.O.S. Proper Shipping Names.

CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.question: Which one of these labels would be attached to a package containing explosives?
Which one of the following is a definition of the control temperature of a dangerous substance as applicable to the IMDG Code?
options: The maximum temperature at which certain substances, such as organic peroxides and self-reactive and related substances can be safely transported during a prolonged period of time.
The lowest temperature at which decomposition may occur for a substance in a packaging as used in transport.
The temperature at which emergency procedures shall be implemented.
The overall average temperature drawn from daily observations on passage.
CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.answer: The maximum temperature at which certain substances, such as organic peroxides and self-reactive and related substances can be safely transported during a prolonged period of time.

CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.question: A cargo transport unit contains 50 drums, each with the UN number 2967 displayed on it. Which number should be displayed in the lower half of the diamond on the placard on the front, rear and both sides of the unit?
Which one of the options does the mark shown here indicate when found on a package?
options: The package contains dangerous goods in Excepted Quantities
The package contains dangerous goods meeting European Union regulations
The package contains a marine pollutant subject to MARPOL Annex 2
The package contains 2.2 Kg of Class 1 explosives
CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.answer: The package contains dangerous goods in Excepted Quantities

CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.question: What material would a drum, the marking on which began with                            be constructed from?
options: Metal, other than steel or aluminium.

CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.question: Which one of the following symbols would you expect to find on a thermal tank containing liquid of a high temperature?
Which one of the following statements is correct?
options: The hazard posed by a substance can arise from a dangerous reaction of the substance or article with other substances in the surrounding environment.
Substances in the surrounding environment can have no dangerous impact on packaged dangerous goods.

A dangerous reaction between a substance or article and other substances in the surrounding environment is only possible if those goods are packaged in a container constructed of soft and non water-resistant material.
CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.answer: The hazard posed by a substance can arise from a dangerous reaction of the substance or article with other substances in the surrounding environment.

CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.question: Which one of the following is a valid example of a mark for a packaging containing substances of class 6.2?
Which one of the following is used to denote a Marine Pollutant in the Dangerous Goods List?
The classes used by the UN for the IMDG Code are based on which ONE of the following?
options: The type of hazard that Dangerous Goods present.
The alphabetical order of the list of commonly shipped Dangerous Goods.
The UN Numbers of Dangerous Goods.
The results of accredited laboratory tests of different chemical groups.
CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.answer: The type of hazard that Dangerous Goods present.

CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.question: Which one of these is the UN Packaging Symbol?
As defined within the IMDG Code, the term “marking” refers to which one of the following?
options: Identification of the substance contained in a package.
Identification of the risks and hazards presented by substances contained in a package.
Identification of the risks and hazards presented by substances contained in cargo transport units.
Identification of the consignor of the article.
CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.answer: Identification of the substance contained in a package.

CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.question: What are the Proper Shipping Name and UN Number for the substance Bromomethane?
options: METHYL BROMIDE with not more than 2.0% chloropicrin UN 1062.
CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.answer: METHYL BROMIDE with not more than 2.0% chloropicrin UN 1062.

CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.question: As defined within the IMDG Code, the term “labelling” refers to which one of the following?
options: Identification of the risks and hazards presented by substances contained in a package.
Identification of the substance contained in a package.
Identification of the risks and hazards presented by substances contained in cargo transport units.
Identification of the consignor of the article.
CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.answer: Identification of the risks and hazards presented by substances contained in a package.

CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.question: What is the maximum permitted temperature on the outer surface of the shell of a portable tank, or its thermal insulation, during transportation?
Which one of the following statements most accurately describes salvage packaging in relation to the IMDG Code?
options: Special packaging into which damaged, defective, leaking or non-conforming packages or dangerous goods that have spilled or leaked are placed for the purposes of transport for recovery or disposal.
Packaging which has been reconditioned after previous use.
Packaging which is manufactured from recycled material.
Packaging in which goods recovered from the sea are held, pending investigation by the appropriate authority.
CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.answer: Special packaging into which damaged, defective, leaking or non-conforming packages or dangerous goods that have spilled or leaked are placed for the purposes of transport for recovery or disposal.

CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.question: Packages of UN 2805 and UN 1120 are intended for transport by sea. Which of the following applies?
options: Must be stowed away from each other.
Must be separated from each other.
Must be separated by a complete compartment or hold from each other.
Must be separated longitudinally by an intervening complete compartment or hold from each other.
CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.answer: Must be separated from each other.

CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.question: To what specific source of safety information, as indicated in this program, would you refer in the case of a spillage of a substance identified with the UN number 1230?
Which one of the following code prefixes, as used in the Dangerous Goods List, is applied to Special Packing Instructions for Packagings other than IBC’s and Large Packagings?
Unless otherwise provided for in the Code, a package containing dangerous goods of UN Number 2196 should be marked as which one of the following?
The Medical First Aid Guide for Use in Accidents Involving Dangerous Goods provides advice intended for which one of the following?
options: The initial management of chemical poisoning/toxic effects and diagnosis within the limits of the facilities available at sea.
The comprehensive and total management of chemical poisoning and diagnosis to full recovery, with assistance from shore as required.
The proper documentation to the flag state authority in the event of a fatality involving dangerous goods on a vessel.
The accurate transfer of information relating to a spilled cargo to the appropriate shoreside medical and environmental agencies.
CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.answer: The initial management of chemical poisoning/toxic effects and diagnosis within the limits of the facilities available at sea.

CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.question: Which one of the three Packing Groups is assigned to substances presenting the lowest level of danger?

According to the IMDG Code, a portable tank, with capacity 3000 litres or more, which is loaded with dangerous goods and which is intended for transport by sea, must display the placards as described by which one of the following statements?
options: On each side and on each end of the tank.
On each side and on the back end of the tank.
CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.answer: On each side and on each end of the tank.

CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.question: What special packing provisions would apply to an IBC, of construction code 11A, used for the transportation of OSMIUM TETROXIDE?
options: Such an IBC shall be carried in a closed cargo transport unit or in a freight container or vehicle, which shall have rigid sides or fences at least to the height of the IBC.
Such an IBC shall be sift-proof and water-resistant or shall be fitted with a sift-proof or water-resistant liner.
Such an IBC shall meet the performance group II performance level.
IBCs shall not be used for the transportation of this substance.
CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.answer: Such an IBC shall be carried in a closed cargo transport unit or in a freight container or vehicle, which shall have rigid sides or fences at least to the height of the IBC.

CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.question: What does the Code say about the transportation of CHLOROPRENE, STABILIZED as a “limited quantity”?
options: The entry in column 7(a) of the Dangerous Goods List is “0” and therefore indicates that this substance cannot be transported as a limited quantity shipment.
The entry in column 7(b) of the Dangerous Goods List is “E0” and therefore indicates that there is no restriction on this substance being transported as a limited quantity shipment.

The entry in column 16(b) of the Dangerous Goods List has code “SW2” which means that the substance should be stowed clear of living quarters. A limited quantity can therefore be carried, provided it is stowed more than 24 metres away from the accommodation.
The entry in column 8 of the Dangerous Goods List refers the user to a Packing Instruction 0, which explains how the substance may be transported under “Limited Quantity” requirements.`
CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.answer: The entry in column 7(a) of the Dangerous Goods List is “0” and therefore indicates that this substance cannot be transported as a limited quantity shipment.

CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.question: When a Cargo Transport Unit is loaded with a mixture of dangerous goods and non-hazardous materials, how should the dangerous goods consignments be loaded?
options: Wherever possible, adjacent to the doors, with labels and markings visible.
On the bottom of the unit, to ensure no damage of other cargo occurs in the event of leakage.
Away from all doors or openings to prevent falling out when the unit is opened.
On top of the non-hazardous material, so as to be readily accessible for priority unloading.
CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.answer: Wherever possible, adjacent to the doors, with labels and markings visible.

CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.question: Which one of the following is the definition of a “consignee”, as indicated in the IMDG Code?
options: Any person, organization or Government that is entitled to take delivery of a consignment.
Any person who prepares a shipment for transport.
A member of a competent authority charged with the administration of the transportation of dangerous goods.
CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.answer: Any person, organization or Government that is entitled to take delivery of a consignment.

CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.question: According to the guidelines in the IMDG Code, what is the maximum mean temperature that should be used in calculations to ensure that the filling of an IBC does not exceed 98% of its water capacity?
What medical warnings are found in the Dangerous Goods List for 3-TRIFLUOROMETHYLANILINE?
options: Toxic if swallowed, by skin contact or by inhalation.
Causes burns to skin, eyes and mucous membranes.
High rate of skin decomposition on prolonged contact.
CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.answer: Toxic if swallowed, by skin contact or by inhalation.

CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.question: A “Dangerous Goods Declaration" is not required to be provided by the consignor when shipping a package marked “Dangerous Goods of Class 3– Limited Quantity”. Which one of the following is a correct assessment of this statement?
options: True, but only when the total quantity does not exceed 5 litres.
True, but only when contained in rigid containers of not more than 0.3 m³ capacity, contained within an inner packaging.

CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.question: Packages of UN 0477 and UN 2008 are intended for transport by sea. Which one of the following applies?
options: Must be stowed away from each other.
Must be separated by a complete compartment or hold from each other.
Must be separated longitudinally by an intervening complete compartment or hold from each other.
CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.answer: Must be separated by a complete compartment or hold from each other.

CD0151 — HAZMAT - IMDG Code, Advanced.question: A fibreboard package containing 4 metal cans of Caesium Nitrate, individual weight 1kg each, transported under the provisions of chapter 3.4 of the Code, will bear which of the following markings?
Which one of the following is a design feature of all Intermediate Bulk Containers?
options: They must be suitable for handling by mechanical means.
They must be individually approved by the Flag State authority.
They must be capable of withstanding a drop test of 12 metres.
They must be fitted with a minimum of three pressure-relief valves.
