CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: The ISPS Code.

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: 通常认为是哪个海事守则导致了最近几年很多区域偷渡者数量的减少？
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: ISPS Code。

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: The charterer may be liable for some or all of the costs associated with stowaways.  Under what circumstances could this be the case?
options: Special provision may be written into the charter party, indicating that the charterer accepts responsibility for costs when stowaways have hidden in the charterer’s goods and boarded the vessel in that way.
Charterers are always totally exempt from liability for costs associated with stowaways under international law.
Special provision may be incorporated in the Mate’s Receipt, indicating that costs associated with stowaways will be determined by arbitration in the flag State of the chartered vessel.
Charterers are always legally responsible for all costs associated with stowaways on vessels contracted to them under international law.
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: Special provision may be written into the charter party, indicating that the charterer accepts responsibility for costs when stowaways have hidden in the charterer’s goods and boarded the vessel in that way.

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: 承租方可能要负责与偷渡者相关的部分或全部成本。什么情况下由它负责？
options: 承租方编写了特殊条款，表明承租方接受偷渡者藏匿于承租方货物中且以这种方式登船时的成本。
按照国际法律的规定，承租方完全不用支付与偷渡者相关的成本。
装货收据内可能包含了特殊条款，表明与偷渡者相关的成本将由承租船舶船旗国的仲裁决定。
根据国际法律的规定，承租方总是应该依法承担与租用给他们的船舶上的偷渡者相关的所有成本。
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: 承租方编写了特殊条款，表明承租方接受偷渡者藏匿于承租方货物中且以这种方式登船时的成本。

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: What is the name applied to the process of returning a person to his country of origin called?
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: Repatriation.

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: 将人员返回其始发国的过程叫什么名字？
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: 遣返。

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: If practicable, how should a claim for asylum be made?
options: It should be in writing, in the language of the writer and handed to the immigration authorities.
It should be made verbally by the individual to the Port Security Officer.
It should be in writing, in the language of the arrival port and handed to the agent.
It should be in writing, in the language of the arrival port and reproduced in English and handed to the Port Security Officer.
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: It should be in writing, in the language of the writer and handed to the immigration authorities.

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: 如果可行，应该如何进行庇护申请？
options: 应以申请者自己的语言书写，且交给移民局。
应由个人口头向港口安全官员提出。
应以到港语言书写，且交给代理机构。
应以到港语言书写然后翻译为英文，且交给港口安全官员。
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: 应以申请者自己的语言书写，且交给移民局。

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: Which of the following is the definition of the term “place of safety” in the IMO Guidelines on the Treatment of Persons Rescued at Sea?
options: A place where a survivor’s safety of life is no longer threatened and where their basic human needs can be met.
A state where a refugee’s claim for asylum will be recognized.
A location where medical treatment is available and a refugee will be housed and fed, pending processing by the authorities.
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: A place where a survivor’s safety of life is no longer threatened and where their basic human needs can be met.

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: 根据 IMO 关于海上营救人员处理的指南，下面哪个是“安全位置”的定义？
options: 幸存者的生命安全不再受到威胁，且其基本人体需求可以得到满足的位置。
认定难民庇护申请的国家。
可以提供医疗处理，难民有居住地和食品同时等待当局处理的位置。
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: 幸存者的生命安全不再受到威胁，且其基本人体需求可以得到满足的位置。

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: Assuming no claim is being made for asylum, what will immigration authorities invariably consider necessary before permitting disembarkation of a stowaway?
options: A letter of invitation from a friend in that country.
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: Valid travel documents.

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: 假设没有申请庇护，移民局在允许偷渡者上岸之前通常认为必需提供什么内容？
options: 来自该国朋友的邀请函。
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: 有效的旅行证件。

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: You have departed a port in South America and are bound for the United States.  You discover a stowaway on board.  Should he be forced into making a claim for political asylum?
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: No.

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: 您已经离开了南美的某个港口，正在前往美国。您发现船上有个偷渡者。此时应该强制他进行政治庇护申请吗？
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: 否。

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: The master has been presented with papers to sign relating to stowaways he had on board on arrival in port and is uncertain as to their significance.  What should he do?
options: He should communicate with his owners and seek instructions.
He should ask the Port Security Officer for guidance.
He should refuse to sign them under any circumstances.
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: He should communicate with his owners and seek instructions.

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: 有一些与船只到港时船上偷渡者相关的文件已经交给了船长进行签署，但他对其重要性不确定。他应该怎么做？
options: 应该与船东联系并寻求指导。
应该向港口安全官员寻求指导。
在任何情况下均应拒绝签署。
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: 应该与船东联系并寻求指导。

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: The FAL Convention established a definition for an “attempted stowaway”.  What critical condition in this definition distinguishes it from the definition for a “stowaway”?
options: That the person was discovered before the ship departed from the port.
That the person intended to stow away, but was unable to board the vessel due to some exceptional circumstance.
That the person was intercepted by security personnel within the port complex.
That the person was not in possession of a valid ticket to travel.
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: That the person was discovered before the ship departed from the port.

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: FAL 公约还规定了“尝试偷渡者”的定义。在此定义中，哪个严格条件将其与“偷渡者”定义进行了区分？
options: 船只离开港口前发现了此类人。
此类人意图偷渡，但由于某些特殊情况无法登船。
此类人在港口设施内被警卫人员拦截。
此类人没有有效的旅行票据。
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: 船只离开港口前发现了此类人。

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: Which convention, associated with the streamlining of paperwork for the international maritime trade, gave a detailed, legal interpretation to the term “Stowaway”?
options: The Convention on Facilitation of International Maritime Traffic (1965 FAL Convention).
The 1957 International Convention relating to Stowaways.
The International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS 1974).
The First United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS 1956).
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: The Convention on Facilitation of International Maritime Traffic (1965 FAL Convention).

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: 哪个公约结合国际海事贸易纸面工作的精简给出了“偷渡者”一词详细的法律解释？
options: 关于国际海洋交通便利化的公约（1965 FAL 公约）。
关于偷渡者的 1957 国际公约。
海上生命安全国际公约 (SOLAS 1974)。
有关海上法律的第一部联合国公约 (UNCLOS 1956)。
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: 关于国际海洋交通便利化的公约（1965 FAL 公约）。

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: Which of the following is the definition of “asylum seekers” as recorded in this chapter?
options: Persons who have left their country of origin, have applied for recognition as refugees in another country and are awaiting a decision on their application.
People attempting to escape war, civil unrest, or political or religious persecution.
Persons having no intention of making their presence known to the authorities, hoping to enter a country undetected.
Migrants, demanding to travel to another country which is not their own, with the expressed intention of adopting citizenship of that country.
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: Persons who have left their country of origin, have applied for recognition as refugees in another country and are awaiting a decision on their application.

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: 根据本章内容，下面哪个是“寻求庇护者”的定义？
options: 离开其始发国家，已经申请被确定为作为另一个国家的难民，正在等待申请决定的人。
试图逃离战争、内乱，或政治或宗教迫害的人。
不打算被当局知道他们的存在，希望在不被发现的情况下进入某个国家。
移民希望进入到不是自己国家的另一个国家，具有明确的愿望要成为该国家的公民。
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: 离开其始发国家，已经申请被确定为作为另一个国家的难民，正在等待申请决定的人。

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: What is the essential difference between the administration of political asylum and modern refugee law?
options: Political asylum is an individual matter, usually dealt with on a case-by-case basis, while modern refugee law deals with large movements of population.
Political asylum involves membership of an oppressed political movement, while modern refugee law deliberately ignores political aspects of an individual’s claim to asylum.
Political asylum deals with multiple claims for admission to a country of sanctuary, while modern refugee law examines each individual claim on a case-by-case basis.
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: Political asylum is an individual matter, usually dealt with on a case-by-case basis, while modern refugee law deals with large movements of population.

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: 政治庇护和现代难民法律管理之间的重要区别是什么？
options: 政治庇护是个人的事情，通常根据情况而不同进行处理，而现代难民法律处理大批人员的移动。
政治庇护涉及受压迫的政治运动的成员身份，而现代难民法律则有意忽略个人申请庇护时的政治原因。
政治庇护处理进入避难国家的多起申请，而现代难民法律根据每个情况审核每个申请。
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: 政治庇护是个人的事情，通常根据情况而不同进行处理，而现代难民法律处理大批人员的移动。

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: Which of the following is the correct definition of a “displaced person” as recorded in this module?
options: A person who, as a result of the actions of the authorities, has been deported from, or has been forced to leave the country of his or her nationality or former habitual residence.
A person who is discovered in a place that is not their country of citizenship or residency.
A person who is found on travelling away from their place of residency without appropriate documentation to explain their reason for travel.
A person who has been granted permission to reside in a new country.
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: A person who, as a result of the actions of the authorities, has been deported from, or has been forced to leave the country of his or her nationality or former habitual residence.

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: 根据本章内容，以下哪个是“流离失所人员”的正确定义？
options: 由于当局的措施而被驱逐出境，或被强制离开自己的国籍国或前居住地的人员。
在不是其公民身份所在国家或居住国被发现的人。
发现离开其居住地履行，但没有恰当的文件来解释其旅行原因的人。
被一个新的国家授予停留权限的人。
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: 由于当局的措施而被驱逐出境，或被强制离开自己的国籍国或前居住地的人员。

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: Is a person picked up by a ship at sea automatically given official refugee status?
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: No.

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: 在海上被船只救起的人是否会被自动授予正式难民身份？
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: 否。

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: Which Code, implemented in 2004, made it more difficult for potential stowaways to gain access to a vessel in port?
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: The ISPS Code.

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: 2004 年实施的哪个守则使得潜在偷渡者在港口上船变得更难了？
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: ISPS Code。

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: As part of the preparations for entering port, storage lockers, machinery rooms, deckhouses, accesses to cargo holds, pumprooms not in use and any other areas which do not need to be open for the purposes of cargo handling or safety should be locked or sealed.  What precaution should be taken before this is done?
options: It should be established that no ship’s personnel are working inside.
It should be checked that any ventilation schedule is completed.
It should be established that there are at least three sets of “master keys” available on board.
Warning notices, in English, the language of the crew and the local language should be affixed on the outside of all locked doors.
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: It should be established that no ship’s personnel are working inside.

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: 作为进入港口准备工作的一部分，储藏库、机械房、甲板房、货舱出入口、不使用的泵房，以及出于货物搬运或安全目的不需要打开的任何其他区域应该锁闭或密封。在此之前应该采取什么预防措施？
options: 应该确定里面没有船只人员在作业。
应该检查是否完成了任何通风计划。
应该确定船上至少有三套“船长钥匙”。
在所有锁闭门的外侧均应张贴英语、船员使用语言和当地语言的警告通知。
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: 应该确定里面没有船只人员在作业。

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: If a person manages to gain access to a ship in port and conceal himself, but is discovered during a search prior to the vessel’s departure, what legal status will normally be applied to him?
options: He is considered as a trespasser.
He is regarded as a stowaway.
He is judged to be a common citizen of that country.
He is listed as a refugee.
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: He is considered as a trespasser.

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: 如果有人设法进入港口内船只并藏匿其中，但在船舶离港前被搜索发现，通常会对其实施什么法律状态？
options: 他被判决为该国的普通公民。
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: 他被视为一名侵入者。

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: Why should a record of persons coming on board be maintained by the ship’s staff?
options: So that a later check can be made that they have gone ashore before the ship departs.
So that the vessel is seen to be in compliance during an audit.
So that the Chief Officer can check that the gangway watchman has been present at his post throughout.
So that the foreman stevedore can establish the location of his work team.
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: So that a later check can be made that they have gone ashore before the ship departs.

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: 为什么船员应该保留一份登船人员记录？
options: 为了在船离港前进行检查，看他们是否已经上岸。
为了在审核期间表现船舶的合规性。
为了让大副检查舷梯岗哨人员是否在其岗位上。
为了码头装卸负责人可以了解其作业团队的位置。
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: 为了在船离港前进行检查，看他们是否已经上岸。

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: You are conducting a pre-departure stowaway search.  How should you proceed if you discover someone concealed in the paint locker?
options: Immediately report your finding to the Responsible Officer. Do not attempt to physically restrain the person.  Secure the door to prevent his escape.  Stand by for assistance from the shore authorities.
Summon a colleague and physically remove the person to the ship’s office.  Secure the locker door to prevent any further stowaways entering.
Seal the locker and report your finding to the Responsible Officer at the end of the search.
Immediately report your finding to the foreman stevedore and request that he takes action to remove the person to shore.  Make an entry to that effect in the ship’s logbook.
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: Immediately report your finding to the Responsible Officer. Do not attempt to physically restrain the person.  Secure the door to prevent his escape.  Stand by for assistance from the shore authorities.

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: 您正在执行离港前偷渡者搜索。如果发现有人藏匿在涂料间中，您应该怎么做？
options: 立即将您的发现报告给负责官员。不要尝试以身体限制该人员。锁闭门防止其逃跑。等待来自岸上当局的协助。
招呼一位同事，将此人扭送到船只办公室。锁闭门防止任何其他偷渡者进入。
密封涂料间，在搜索的最后将您的发现报告给负责官员。
将您的发现报告给装卸负责人，请求他来采取措施将此人带到岸上。在船只日志簿中进行记录。
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: 立即将您的发现报告给负责官员。不要尝试以身体限制该人员。锁闭门防止其逃跑。等待来自岸上当局的协助。

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: In addition to verifying that all appropriate spaces are locked, what additional purpose is served by patrols?
options: They serve as a visual deterrent to potential stowaways.
They enable duties of the ship’s personnel to be rotated.
The watchkeeping officer can make an entry in the logbook at the end of his watch stating that security has been maintained throughout.
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: They serve as a visual deterrent to potential stowaways.

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: 除了验证所有恰当空间均已锁闭之外，巡逻还有什么目的？
options: 对潜在偷渡者起到视觉震慑作用。
岗哨官员可以在其岗哨结束时在日志簿中进行记录，表明一直在保持安全。
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: 对潜在偷渡者起到视觉震慑作用。

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: Countries that are signatories to the 1979 IMO International Convention on Maritime Search and Rescue are required to ensure that assistance is provided to any person in distress at sea.   Which of the following is a correct statement in this respect?
options: They must do so regardless of nationality or status of such a person or the circumstances in which that person is found.
This applies only to persons identified as being in distress by a vessel carrying their flag.
Provision must only be made to rescue persons of nationalities that are also signatories to the Convention.
The master can choose to disregard any provisions made by his flag State for search and rescue on commercial grounds.
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: They must do so regardless of nationality or status of such a person or the circumstances in which that person is found.

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: 1979 IMO 海上搜救公约签署国必须确保向海上遇险的任何人提供协助。以下哪项关于这方面的陈述正确？
options: 无论此类人员的国籍或身份如何，或者发现他们时的情况如何，均须提供此类协助。
此规定仅适用于被飘扬其旗帜的船只认定为遇险的人员。
供应品只能用来营救也属于公约签署国国籍的人员。
船长可以商业理由选择不考虑其船旗国用于搜救的任何供应。
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: 无论此类人员的国籍或身份如何，或者发现他们时的情况如何，均须提供此类协助。

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: Who in the United Nations organization would have an interest in the large-scale movement of migrants and refugees in a particular sea area?
options: The United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees.
The United Nations Committee on Refugee Movement.
The United Nations Trust for Economic Migrants.
The United Nations Commissioner for Displaced Persons.
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: The United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees.

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: 联合国组织内的什么人会对移民和难民的大规模移动感兴趣，尤其是某个海洋区域的移动？
options: 联合国难民移动委员会。
联合国经济移民基金会。
联合国流离失所人员安置署
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: 联合国难民安置署。

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: Does a stowaway, if discovered in international waters, have any rights?
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: Yes.

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: 如果在国际水域发现偷渡者，他们是否有任何权利？
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: 是。

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: A stowaway has been discovered on board.  Who is responsible for the proper and accurate reporting of the relevant details to the authorities, the owner, charterer and other interested parties?
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: The master.

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: 在船上发现了偷渡者。由谁负责恰当准确地向当局、船东、承租方和其他感兴趣各方报告详细情况？
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: 船长。

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: Under what circumstances may the charterer be liable for some or all of the costs associated with stowaways?
options: When special provision has been made in the charter party, indicating that the charterer accepts responsibility for costs when stowaways have hidden in the charterer’s goods and boarded the vessel by such a method.
Charterers are exempt by international law from liability for costs associated with stowaways.
Where special provision is made in the contract of afreightment that costs associated with stowaways will be equally shared between the ship owner and the charterer.
Charterers are always legally responsible under international law for all costs associated with stowaways on vessels contracted to them.
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: When special provision has been made in the charter party, indicating that the charterer accepts responsibility for costs when stowaways have hidden in the charterer’s goods and boarded the vessel by such a method.

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: 在什么情况下承租方可能要负责与偷渡者相关的部分或全部成本。
options: 承租方编写了特殊条款，表明承租方接受偷渡者藏匿于承租方货物中且以这种方式登船时的成本。
按照国际法律的规定，承租方不用支付与偷渡者相关的成本。
根据运输合同的规定提供特殊供应时，与偷渡者相关的成本将由船东和承租方平均分担。
根据国际法律的规定，承租方总是应该依法承担与租用给他们的船舶上的偷渡者相关的所有成本。
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: 承租方编写了特殊条款，表明承租方接受偷渡者藏匿于承租方货物中且以这种方式登船时的成本。

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: “The master of a ship at sea which is in a position to be able to provide assistance, on receiving information from any source that persons are in distress at sea, is bound to proceed with all speed to their assistance, if possible informing them or the search and rescue services that the ship is doing so.”  Is this a correct statement?
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: Yes.

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: “在海上收到遇险人员任何来源的信息时，如果船只处于能够提供协助的位置，则船长要全速前往提供协助，如果可能应通知他们或搜救服务其船只正在前往。”  这个说法是否正确？
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: 是。

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: How should the master of a vessel regard the level of security in a port at which his vessel calls?
options: He must assess the consequent risk to the vessel of the declared level and adjust his own procedures accordingly.
He should ignore any security risk level declared by the port security organization.
If the port security is declared as adequate, there is no need to implement any measures on board the ship.
He should report the level of security to his owner or operator and secure advice regarding any measures necessary on board.
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: He must assess the consequent risk to the vessel of the declared level and adjust his own procedures accordingly.

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: 船长应该如何考虑要停靠港口的安全水平？
options: 必须根据声明水平对船舶的后续风险进行评估，并相应调节自己的程序。
应该忽略港口安全组织声明的任何安全风险水平。
如果港口安全声明为充分，则无需在船上实施任何措施。
应该向船东或运营方报告安全水平，并获取船上必要任何措施的建议。
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: 必须根据声明水平对船舶的后续风险进行评估，并相应调节自己的程序。

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: Which of the following is a requirement on the master of a seagoing vessel under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea?
options: To render assistance to any person found at sea in danger of being lost.
To establish, operate and maintain such search and rescue facilities as are deemed practicable and necessary to provide a means of locating and rescuing persons at sea.

If in a position to be able to provide assistance, on receiving information from any source that persons are in distress at sea, he is bound to proceed with all speed to their assistance, if possible informing them or the search and rescue services of that the ship is doing so.
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: To render assistance to any person found at sea in danger of being lost.

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: 根据有关海上法律的联合国公约，对于海上航行船舶的船长有什么要求？
options: 为海上发现的处于生命危险中的任何人提供帮助。
架设、操作和维护可行和必要的搜索和营救设施，提供在海上定位和营救人员的方式。
如果船只处于能够提供协助的位置，则船长要全速前往提供协助，如果可能应通知他们或搜救服务其船只正在前往。
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: 为海上发现的处于生命危险中的任何人提供帮助。

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: In legal terms, there is a significant difference between “stowaways” and “migrants and refugees” that are rescued at sea.  What is that difference?
options: Stowaways board a ship without permission and without the knowledge of the master, officers and crew, with the intention of remaining on board undetected until the vessel is at sea, while rescued migrants and refugees board a ship with the full knowledge and permission of the master.
Stowaways may often be violent or engaged in criminal activity, while refugees will in general be genuine, law-abiding and cooperative.
Refugees attempt to conceal themselves and escape detection by the authorities, while stowaways openly seek rescue and official approval when the vessel reaches port.

Stowaways always have false identity documents rendering them illegal entrants under international law, while refugees and migrants always carry valid and proper papers which are acceptable to the authorities.
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: Stowaways board a ship without permission and without the knowledge of the master, officers and crew, with the intention of remaining on board undetected until the vessel is at sea, while rescued migrants and refugees board a ship with the full knowledge and permission of the master.

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: 在法律意义上说，“偷渡者”与海上营救的“移民和难民”有着很大的区别。区别是什么？
options: 偷渡者未经允许且在船长、官员和船员不知情的情况下登船，并且意图在不被发现的情况下留在船上，直到船舶到达海上，而被营救的移民和难民是在船长知情和允许的情况下上船的。
偷渡者通常比较暴力或参与犯罪活动，而难民一般则真诚、守法、合作。
难民尝试进行藏匿并逃过当局的搜索，而偷渡者则公开寻求营救，当船舶到港时会公开寻求官方批准。
偷渡者经常具有造假身份文件，按照国际法的规定，这会使其成为非法入境者，而难民和移民则携带可被当局接受的有效恰当的文件。
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: 偷渡者未经允许且在船长、官员和船员不知情的情况下登船，并且意图在不被发现的情况下留在船上，直到船舶到达海上，而被营救的移民和难民是在船长知情和允许的情况下上船的。

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: Do incidents involving stowaways, migrants and refugees at sea cost the ship owner money?
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: Yes

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: 涉及海上偷渡者、移民和难民的事件是否会花费船东的资金？
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: 是

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: In general, which of the following will result in higher costs?
options: Having a stowaway on board when arriving in port.
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: Allowing a stowaway to escape.

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: 一般来说，下面哪个会导致更高的成本？
options: 到达港口时船上有偷渡者。
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: 让偷渡者逃跑。

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: According to the estimates quoted in this program, what is the cost of stowaways to the shipping industry and their P&I Clubs?
options: An average of US$ 30,000 per ship.
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: Around US$ 20,000,000 a year

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: 根据本计划中的估计，偷渡者给航运行业及其保险协会带来的成本是多少？
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: 大约每年 2000 万美元

CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.question: Which maritime code is believed to have led to a reduction in the number of stowaways in many areas recent years?
options: The United Nations International Stowaway Code.
CD0155 — Stowaways, Migrants and Refugee.answer: The ISPS Code.
